jobs.title: Head of Global Compensation & Benefits
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in:

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Head of of Global Compensation & Benefits to architect, implement, and manage our total rewards strategy and operations. This is a critical leadership role responsible for designing equitable, competitive, and scalable programs that will attract, retain, and motivate top talent across the globe. You will be the chief architect of our compensation philosophy and will be instrumental in resolving existing pay inequities and creating a fair and consistent framework for our growing international team.

🚀 What you’ll own:

1. Develop and Implement a Compensation Philosophy

  • Craft a clear, data-driven compensation philosophy that is intrinsically linked to our company values, business strategy, and long-term growth objectives.

  • Collaborate with the executive leadership team to gain alignment and ensure the philosophy serves as the foundational guide for all compensation and rewards decisions.

  • Champion this philosophy throughout the organization to ensure transparency and understanding among leaders and employees.

2. Establish Base Pay, Bonus, and Equity Structures

  • Design and implement globally consistent, yet locally relevant, salary bands, bonus/incentive plans, and equity guidelines.

  • Utilise robust market benchmarking data from multiple sources (e.g., Radford, Mercer) to ensure our compensation is competitive and aligned with our desired market position.

  • Develop clear processes for salary reviews, promotions, and new hire offers to ensure internal equity and consistency.

3. Conduct a Company-Wide Reward Audit

  • Lead a comprehensive audit of all current compensation practices to identify internal pay inequities, market misalignments, and compliance risks across all regions.

  • Conduct a thorough pay equity analysis with an immediate and specific focus on understanding and addressing our flagged gender pay gap.

  • Present findings and provide data-backed, actionable recommendations to leadership for remediating gaps and mitigating future risks.

4. Build Scalable Global Benefits and Total Rewards Programs

  • Design and launch a harmonized global benefits framework that addresses current lack consistency across our regions.

  • Evaluate, select, and manage vendors to provide comprehensive and cost-effective benefits offerings, including health, wellness, retirement, and leave programs that cater to a diverse global workforce.

  • Develop a compelling total rewards communication strategy to help employees understand and appreciate the full value of their compensation and benefits package, driving engagement and retention.

🧠 What you’ll bring to the party:

  • Detailed & progressive experience in Compensation & Benefits, with time spent in a strategic leadership role.

  • Demonstrable experience building and managing compensation and benefits programs on a global or multi-regional scale is essential.

  • Proven expertise in designing a compensation philosophy, creating salary structures, and managing variable pay and equity programs (e.g., RSUs, stock options).

  • Hands-on experience conducting pay equity audits and implementing remediation plans. Familiarity with statistical analysis and pay equity legislation is required.

  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable insights.

  • Global operational benefits management

  • Exceptional communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present complex topics clearly to executive audiences.

  • High level of integrity and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential information.

Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at inclusion@kraken.tech. We’ll do our best to tailor the experience to your needs so you can feel comfortable, confident and be at your best!

Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we’re looking for! At Kraken, we're creating a team of genuine, honest, empathetic people. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. We consider all applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

*Our (i) Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice and Artificial Intelligence (AI) Notice, (ii) Website Privacy Notice and (iii) Cookie Notice govern the collection and use of your personal data in connection with your application and use of our website. These policies explain how we handle your data and outline your rights under applicable laws, including, but not limited to, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your information, object to processing, or withdraw consent. By applying, you acknowledge that you’ve read, understood and consent to these terms

Please note that, in line with our current recruitment policy, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position; applicants must have the right to work in the country that they're applying to, at the time of application.*

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

 

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

 

We’re a technology company focused on creating a smart, sustainable energy system. From optimising renewable generation, creating a more intelligent grid and enabling utilities to provide excellent customer experiences, our operating system for energy is transforming the industry around the world in a way that benefits everyone.

 

It’s a really exciting time in energy. Help us make a real impact on shaping a better, more sustainable future.

 

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

 

We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. 

 

This role will lead the technical orchestration of a major client program, partnering with an international energy retailer in their operational transformation. You will oversee the migration’s technical pillar and manage the ongoing technical relationship, supporting the client’s adoption of our Kraken platform as part of their broader business transformation.

 

We work incredibly dynamically, and this role is one that will take different shapes throughout the week. We are looking for well rounded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity, are self-starters and willing to roll their sleeves up to get to the nitty gritty of a problem. You must be  committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing senior stakeholders through a journey of change. 

 

You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client. 

 

We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • Building trusted relationships with client executives and technology stakeholders, including partnering with our product and engineering teams to align on priorities. Serving as the escalation point for client concerns and ensuring both technical challenges and product requirements are effectively managed

  • Defining success criteria and governance for delivering the technical pillar of the program. 

  • Owning the Kraken platform localisation plan to meet client expectations while matching Kraken roadmap

  •  Summarising and articulating client needs, considerations, timelines, etc internally as structured input for the successful and timely execution of any required technology platform localisation and development.

  • Directing internal Kraken software developers contributing to the client program, as well as potential external Partners, on tech platform deliverables to ensure  an overall successful and timely  technology migration.

  • Supporting the client meets their business needs via the delivery of tech. 

  • Understanding the Kraken infrastructure, aligning client direction with the overall goal for the Kraken platform & business. 

  • Setting up training programs to upskill the technical arm of the client. 

  • Being an advocate for the Kraken way of delivering tech and supporting the client in shifting their mindset around tech delivery

 

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • Communication: You need to be confident in calling out approaches that aren't best for the client and always striving for simplicity.  You need to be able to communicate the context behind decisions relating to the platform & client priorities. You must be able to build strong relationships and credibility amongst senior stakeholders, balancing the needs of the client with Kraken’s business needs and platform potential and constraints.   

  • Program management: Confident in managing a long term, fast paced program. Can be both high level and dive into detail when required. Ability to directly manage a team and manage processes that can drive the right outcomes for clients. 

  • Strong technical aptitude: We are looking for a logical thinker who has strong problem solving skills within an agile working framework. Must quickly be able to grasp the technical capabilities and constraints of the Kraken platform. Is an advocate for the continuous deployment approach we take at Kraken and champions building tech iteratively. 

  • Business acumen: Able to understand business goals of both client and Kraken, putting all technology decisions into context to ensure measurable success can be achieved and celebrated.

  • You are based in Paris, France and willing to travel internationally

Experience / Qualifications needed:

  • Technical mindset, experience in engineering-led industries 

  • You are based in and around Paris and are willing to go to the office 2-3 times per week

  • Sector-relevant experience in managing complex technology implementation or migration programs

  • Proven experience in software adaptation, deployment and integration

  • Exceptional interpersonal skills 

  • Fluent English & French is a prerequisite

As we are an international organization, we  kindly ask you to send us your CV in English. 

 

Kraken is a certified Great Place to Work in France, Germany, Spain, Japan, Australia, and USA. In the UK we are one of the Best Workplaces on Glassdoor with a score of 4.5, and in Germany we rate 4.7 on Kununu as a Top Company. Check out our Welcome to the Jungle site (FR/EN) to learn more about our teams and culture.

 

Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have all the tools and environment you need to unleash your potential. If you have any specific accommodations or a unique preference, please contact us at inclusion@kraken.tech and we'll do what we can to customise your interview process for comfort and maximum magic!

jobs.title: Director Customer Growth, Telco
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in:

We are looking for an Enterprise Sales Leader to lead Kraken's commercial expansion across Europe. The primary job is to get Kraken invited into the strategic conversations where major BSS transformation decisions are being made — before procurement processes begin. Target markets include Europe and Middle East

🚀 What you’ll own:

  • Build and maintain C-suite relationships across Tier 1 and Tier 2 telco operators across Europe

  • Identify BSS transformation programmes and position Kraken ahead of RFP processes

  • Work with industry analysts, advisors, and partners to build market presence and credibility

  • Represent Kraken at European industry events and forums

  • Translate operator pain points into commercially structured opportunities

  • Work closely with the Kraken product and leadership teams to shape how we go to market in Europe

🧠 What you’ll bring to the party:

You are a senior sales or business development leader with deep roots in the European telecoms industry. You open conversations by asking about operating models, not by showing product demos. You think in multi-year relationships, not quarterly bookings.

You will have:

  • A proven track record selling BSS, OSS, or large-scale IT transformation programmes to telco C-suite — ideally from Amdocs, Netcracker, Ericsson, CSG, or other BSS incumbents

  • Alternatively: senior operator-side experience (CDO, VP Transformation, Head of BSS, or CIO direct report) with a strong commercial instinct

  • Deep existing relationships across European operators — you open doors through reputation, not cold outreach

  • Comfort operating at board and C-suite level across technology and commercial functions

  • Intellectual curiosity, gravitas, and low ego — you are consultative by nature

Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at inclusion@kraken.tech. Kraken Customer

 

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. 

 

🏠 Where you'll fit in: 

 

You will be joining the client delivery team with Kraken working to support European clients through their technology transformation journeys, supporting long term migration projects.

The Client Delivery Lead has direct responsibility managing a tech domain (billing, finance, comms..) for our client projects. This is either migrating onto our Kraken platform or managing long term technology requirements. They need to work in partnership with the technology and operational teams at Kraken as well as the client to deliver results for our client’s project or business needs. 

 

The Client Delivery Lead has to really understand how Kraken works, understand problems or requests raised by the client and refine solutions in the best way to leverage existing and new capability. They will bring technology, people and processes together to innovate improvements for our clients. You will also support the client in adapting to ways of working that are aligned to Kraken’s development style. You will work closely with Kraken’s product managers and developers to request development needs and act as a link to the client.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • You will be managing the relationship with client counterparts (often product owners and business owners)

  • You will be the first point of contact for tech development and the escalation and resolution point with customers for specific domain/product issues

  • Being the knowledge base of how Kraken works and how we deliver Kraken Platform

  • Triaging incoming requests and communicating client priorities internally. 

  • Summarising and articulating client needs, considerations, timelines internally to enable the ongoing development of the Kraken platform.

  • Supporting the engineering team to deliver product features

  • Challenging the client to think differently about tech development, having full belief in the continuous iteration and deployment approach we have.

 

This is a hands-on, individual contributor position. The role is European based and your projects could be run from any country, travel is expected as part of this role.

 

We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever changing environment. To thrive here you must be a self-starter and willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem, constantly flexing outside of your typical job role to drive progress for our clients and organisation.

You must be  committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing stakeholders through a journey of change. 

 

You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client. 

 

We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • In this position you will be laser focused on satisfying our customer’s needs. We are looking for people with strong problem solving skills and a super positive solutions oriented mindset. If you have a taste for raising up to challenges and a winner mindset, this position is the right fit for you! (“Every problem has a solution, facing new challenges is exciting because that’s what makes us better every day and the bigger the challenge, the bigger the feeling of success”)

  • Strong client delivery and/or product ownership experience

  • Agile delivery experience 

  • Experience of product management and customer journeys

  • Solid understanding of technology and associated trends

  • Excellent communications, collaboration and presentation skills

  • Strong influencing skills and ability to challenge traditional ways of thinking

  • Experience of working with significant complex delivery pipelines for clients

  • Patience and initiative - our clients are undergoing huge transformations that take time and require our understanding 

  • Time management and a get-stuff-done attitude

  • Consulting experience is a plus 

  • Fluent English + Spanish (other european languages are also relevant for this role)

  • Previous experience in the electricity/utilities market and in payments in Spain or another European country is a strong "nice to have"

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken is a global energy transition company touching nearly every point in the energy value chain and is valued at over $9 billion. It is one of energy-tech’s fastest-growing private companies, having won innumerable prizes in just 10 years of existence!

 

Kraken Technologies launched to market five years ago, offering energy utilities one simple end-to-end customer management and local flexibility optimisation solution (Kraken) to help them and their customers transition to a decarbonised future. The Kraken platform is effectively the operating system for utilities, at the core of how they run their business.

 

Kraken Technologies is growing rapidly, disrupting the incumbent tech landscape, with over 90 million end-customer accounts contracted across 11 markets globally and managing the optimisation of over 65GW. Kraken has secured licensing deals with large international energy clients to replace their core technology stack and re-image their operations with an unblemished track record of transformation success. 

 

We are tracking toward 100 million customer accounts on the platform by 2027.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • Be accountable for the successful execution of client implementation programs using our Build-Operate-Transfer methodology, which covers technology, operations and cultural transformation

  • Find solutions that bring our clients into the new software and operating model that both accelerates delivery and reduces risk

  • Develop deep relationships with our clients’ C-suite client executives

  • Communicate effectively to stakeholders at all levels, both internally and externally

  • Continuously demonstrate Kraken’s business value to the client and build a governance model which can last once the implementation program is completed

  • Set the direction and pace for program execution. Managing internal and external expectations, removing blockers and making prioritization decisions to enable successful client transformations 

  • Understand the program details and report progress to both client and internal stakeholders

  • Embody the Kraken ways of working. Provide support and feedback to members of the Kraken team and reinforce an environment of psychological safety.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • Proven track record of leading significant business transformation projects leveraging Agile principles, ideally within utilities or similar complex industries.

  • Being able to lead software delivery engagements with our clients.

  • Demonstrated ability to present and negotiate with C-suite executives, and to initiate strategic discussions. 

  • Pragmatic and effective problem solver, capable of focusing efforts on critical priorities.

  • Strong client-centric approach with a focus on understanding and enabling client success while demonstrating the ability to manage expectations. 

  • Collaborative team player with experience working effectively across local and global teams.

  • Exceptional communication and facilitation skills in both English and Japanese. You are well respected with natural gravitas and can navigate both business cultures seamlessly.

  • Strong client and quality focus, with a proven ability to build and enhance customer relationships.

  • Willingness to travel as required to build face-to-face relationships with clients and internal teams. 

  • Fluent in Japanese and English.

  • Experience in the Japanese utilities sector is highly desirable.

💜 Our culture:

  • Kraken is at the forefront of innovation in the energy industry and we succeed in large part thanks to our people. To fit well at Kraken, you’ll also need to be:

  • Passionate about helping clients (without them, we don’t exist)

  • Passionate about technology (we are a tech business disrupting energy) 

  • A passionate advocate for decarbonisation and fighting climate change

  • Committed to sustainability (we are all about speeding up the shift to a more sustainable world) 

  • Open-minded, curious, flexible and adaptable (we are constantly growing, changing and evolving) 

  • Confident in decision-making 

  • Supportive 

  • Approachable and fun to work with

  • Inclusive

  • Resilient, working well under pressure 

  • A believer in big ambitions and small egos

Kraken is a certified Great Place to Work in France, Germany, Spain, Japan, Australia, and USA. In the UK we are one of the Best Workplaces on Glassdoor with a score of 4.5. Check out our Welcome to the Jungle site (FR/EN) to learn more about our teams and culture.

jobs.title: Senior Client Lead - Organisation Design & Transformation
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

We are currently implementing Kraken into a large Japanese client, and are looking to expand the team leading operational transformation alongside the platform implementation. 

The Senior Client Implementation Lead will lead overall projects on both the operating model e.g. how things are organised and get done around here, as well as the operating environment with direct responsibility for coordinating, managing, building, and delivering Kraken’s cultural change programmes alongside our client. They will need to work in partnership with the technology teams, Product Managers, and client teams. 

The Client Implementation Leads: live & breathe the Kraken ways of working, identify problems, create solutions, workshops and training, and effectively communicate these to our clients. They will bring technology, people, and processes together to innovate business cultural change for our clients.

 

🚀 What you'll own: 

Aiding in the operations transformation of clients:

As a Senior Client Implementation Lead, you would be leading the Client Implementation projects in designing cultural programmes and executing their delivery.

Work with the Kraken Transformation Director to successfully navigate clients through Kraken transformation.

Collaborate with the wider Kraken Technologies Implementation team and clients to develop and deliver a wider range of cultural transformation programmes, including leadership development.

Aid in the creation of plans, timelines, and resources required for successful deployment

Keeping track of project progress, escalating issues, and resolving blockers when they arise.

 

Coaching and workshop delivery:

Work closely with the wider Kraken Tech team to deliver programs to clients as part of their operational transformation journeys

Prepare and deliver workshop content for leadership development

Work with the client to identify needs-based operational analysis and help them translate this into programmes to deliver to their teams

 

We are a fast-growing company that is rapidly expanding globally and travel may be required. 

You will work incredibly dynamically, and this role is one that will take different shapes throughout the week. We are looking for well-rounded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity, are self-starters and willing to roll their sleeves up to work directly with clients. 

You must be committed to the Kraken way of delivering agile operations based on freedom, autonomy and trust that coexists with a simplified, evolving technology platform. 

You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client.

 

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • Curiosity and initiative: If you have an eye for detail, enjoy self learning and aren't afraid to "try and see" then this is the job for you. Supported by a fab team, this is an independent role where success relies on you trusting your gut and taking initiative.

  • Time Management: Able to work independently with minimal supervision, as well as working as a team to deliver projects. You should be able to effectively plan your time and prioritise tasks and the client.

  • Influential Communicator: Comfortable communicating the Kraken way of thinking and to provide updates on feature developments. Can lead meetings and drive forward the development strategy within your domain. Can build supporting slides, Gantt charts, and flow diagrams to aid this.

  • Patience: Our clients are going through significant change, and you need to be able to support them through that curve at a pace that can sometimes feel slower than you might expect. Explanations will need patience and repetition. However, you will also need to be flexible with making changes to programmes and approaches where there is a territory specific need.

  • Business Transformation Expertise: Proven track record in leading business process reengineering (BPR) and transformation projects, driving operational excellence and efficiency.

  • Organisational Development: Expertise in organisational development, including enhancing structure, culture, and processes to support business objectives.

  • Senior Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated experience in managing and engaging with senior stakeholders, ensuring alignment and facilitating effective communication.

  • Project & Program Management: Strong background in managing and executing complex projects and programs, with a focus on delivering results within scope, time, and budget.

  • Training and Coaching: Experience in designing and delivering training programs, and coaching teams to enhance performance and foster professional development.

  • Language Requirement: Native in Japanese and business level of English

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

 

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

 

We’re a technology company focused on creating a smart, sustainable energy system. From optimising renewable generation, creating a more intelligent grid and enabling utilities to provide excellent customer experiences, our operating system for energy is transforming the industry around the world in a way that benefits everyone.

 

It’s a really exciting time in energy. Help us make a real impact on shaping a better, more sustainable future.

 

🏠 Where you'll fit in: 

 

We are looking for brilliant Client Delivery Leads across a number of areas (i.e. Billing/Payments/Communications/Commercials/Markets etc) to help us build an industry leading product experience for our clients. If you love making things better for customers, building great products, working with technology, bringing people together to find solutions, then you’ve come to the right place. 

 

We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for hands-on Client Delivery Leads who can work as an individual contributor, that can help build our capability across our business with Kraken and other 3rd parties as we continue to grow. Our Delivery Leads are here to solve complex problems with great products. 

 

The Client Delivery Lead has direct responsibility for creating, managing and prioritising the operations product roadmap to ensure clarity and understanding with both the Kraken and client business. They need to always work in partnership with the technology and operational teams at Kraken as well as the client. The Delivery Lead has to really understand how Kraken works, identify problems and refine solutions in the best way to leverage existing and new capability. They will bring technology, people and processes together to innovate improvements for our clients.

 

They will deal with complexity across multiple customer journeys with a variety of customer types and end users.  This person will play a critical role in bringing all the right people together to deliver the roadmap.  

🚀 What you'll own:

  • Work closely with clients to deliver implementations, enhancements, and strategic support for their use of Kraken

  • Identify new ideas and technology to improve the product

  • Ensure a balance between flexibility for the client and efficiency for the product

  • Support the business with issue resolution for the product

  • Support the engineering teams to deliver product features

  • Ensure we are constantly reviewing and adapting to customer and business needs

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • Degree qualified equivalent, with strong client delivery and/or product ownership experience

  • Strong agile delivery experience and product management skills

  • Experience of product management and customer journeys

  • Solid understanding of technology and associated trends

  • Excellent communications, collaboration and presentation skills

  • Strong influencing skills and ability to challenge traditional ways of thinking

  • Experience of working with significant complex delivery pipelines for clients

  • Patience - our clients are undergoing huge transformations that take time and require our understanding 

  • Laser focus on clients, relentless problem solving, invincible attitude, a winner!

  • Consulting experience is a plus 

  • Japanese and English speaking 

  • Travelling is required

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏠 Where you'll fit in: 

 

We are looking for brilliant Senior Client Delivery Leads across a number of areas (i.e. Billing/Debt/etc) to help us build an industry leading product experience for our clients. If you love making things better for customers, building great products, working with technology, bringing people together to find solutions, then you’ve come to the right place. 

 

We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for hands-on Senior Client Delivery Lead who can work as an individual contributor, that can help build our capability across our business with Kraken and other 3rd parties as we continue to grow. Our Delivery Leads are here to solve complex problems with great products. 

 

The Client Delivery Lead has direct responsibility for creating, managing and prioritising the operations product roadmap to ensure clarity and understanding with both the Kraken and client business. They need to always work in partnership with the technology and operational teams at Kraken as well as the client. The Delivery Lead has to really understand how Kraken works, identify problems and refine solutions in the best way to leverage existing and new capability. They will bring technology, people and processes together to innovate improvements for our clients.

 

They will deal with complexity across multiple customer journeys with a variety of customer types and end users.  This person will play a critical role in bringing all the right people together to deliver the roadmap.  

🚀 What you'll own:

  • Work closely with the operation and non operation and Kraken Technologies Teams to define the product vision and strategy

  • Identify new ideas and technology to improve the product

  • Define the MVP and test & learn approach for the product capability

  • Support the business with issue resolution for the product

  • Support the engineering teams to deliver product features

  • Managing the relationship with client counterparts, being the first point of contact for tech development and issue resolution. 

  • Triaging incoming requests and communicating client priorities to the right domains in the development team. 

  • Ensure we are constantly reviewing and adapting to customer and business needs

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • Degree qualified equivalent, with strong client delivery and/or product ownership experience

  • Strong agile delivery experience and product management skills

  • Experience of product management and customer journeys

  • Solid understanding of technology and associated trends

  • Excellent communications, collaboration and presentation skills

  • Strong influencing skills and ability to challenge traditional ways of thinking

  • Experience of working with significant complex delivery pipelines for clients

  • Patience - our clients are undergoing huge transformations that take time and require our understanding 

  • Laser focus on clients, relentless problem solving, invincible attitude, a winner!

  • Consulting experience is a plus 

  • Japanese and English speaking 

  • Travelling is required

Kraken is a certified Great Place to Work in France, Germany, Spain, Japan, Australia, and USA. In the UK we are one of the Best Workplaces on Glassdoor with a score of 4.5. Check out our Welcome to the Jungle site (FR/EN) to learn more about our teams and culture.

Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at inclusion@kraken.tech. We’ll do our best to tailor the experience to your needs so you can feel comfortable, confident and be at your best!

Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we’re looking for! At Kraken, we're creating a team of genuine, honest, empathetic people. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. We consider all applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

*Our (i) Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice and Artificial Intelligence (AI) Notice, (ii) Website Privacy Notice and (iii) Cookie Notice govern the collection and use of your personal data in connection with your application and use of our website. These policies explain how we handle your data and outline your rights under applicable laws, including, but not limited to, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your information, object to processing, or withdraw consent. By applying, you acknowledge that you’ve read, understood and consent to these terms

Please note that, in line with our current recruitment policy, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position; applicants must have the right to work in the country that they're applying to, at the time of application.*

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in

As Director, Customer Success – Japan, you will lead Kraken’s most strategic client relationships in Japan while building and shaping our Customer Success presence in the region.

This is a high-impact role at the intersection of technology, transformation, and long-term client partnerships.

You will operate both as a Client Partner for key accounts and as the regional leader for Customer Success in Japan.

This role is critical to Kraken’s success in Japan as we expand our presence, build long-term partnerships with utilities, and adapt our model to local market dynamics.


Why This Role Matters

Japan is a key growth market for Kraken.

This role is central to building long-term, trusted client relationships, delivering successful client outcomes, and establishing Kraken’s Customer Success model in the region.

You will play a foundational role in shaping how we operate and grow in Japan.

Reporting Line

Initial reporting line will be the Director, Customer Success, APAC though this role will have a close working relationship with the Global VP Customer Success. 

🚀 What you’ll own

  • Client Partner – Strategic Account Leadership

    • Own and lead strategic relationships with key clients in Japan

    • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders (C-level and senior leadership)

    • Drive both executive engagement and day-to-day delivery alignment

    • Build deep understanding of client business priorities, regulatory environment, and operational challenges

    • Partner deeply with Technical Account Managers (TAMs), Delivery and Transformation Directors, and Product and Engineering teams

    • Ensure clients achieve meaningful business outcomes, realize full value from Kraken, and are successful and referenceable

    Client Value Realization & Transformation

    • Drive adoption and scaling of Kraken’s platform

    • Connect Kraken’s technology, operating model, and cultural approach to client transformation goals

    • Work in close partnership with Delivery and Transformation Directors to guide clients through migration and ensure a strong transition into long-term operation

    • Maintain continuity and alignment from delivery through to Customer Success

    • Support clients through operational change, digital transformation, and long-term platform adoption

    Escalation Leadership & Risk Management

    • Lead clients through major escalations and critical issues

    • Act as a calm, credible leader in high-pressure situations

    • Partner closely with TAMs to understand technical impact, align on resolution strategy, and represent both business and technical perspectives

    • Work with Delivery and Engineering teams to resolve issues, protect relationships, and maintain client confidence

    Commercial Management & Growth

    • Manage commercial relationships across your accounts

    • Identify and shape expansion opportunities, new product adoption, and long-term growth

    • Align Kraken’s capabilities to evolving client needs

    Regional Leadership – Customer Success (Japan)

    • Build and develop Kraken’s Customer Success presence in Japan

    • Establish ways of working, operating standards, and a regional execution model

    • Scale processes across clients while maintaining quality and consistency

    • Drive regional success:

      • Partner with leaders across TAM, Delivery, Engineering, Product, and Sales

      • Contribute to regional planning, performance tracking, and growth

      • Maintain visibility into client health, risks, and opportunities

      • Support delivery success and long-term customer outcomes

    • Operate as a cross-functional leader:

      • Align priorities across teams and resolve competing demands

      • Influence without authority in a matrixed environment

      • Ensure Kraken shows up as one coordinated partner to clients

    • Partner with global leaders to ensure alignment with Kraken’s operating model and consistency across regions

    How You’ll Work

    • Thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment

    • Balance global strategy, regional nuance, and client-specific needs

    • Demonstrate strong judgment in prioritization, stakeholder management, and decision-making

    • Move fluidly between strategy and execution

🧠 What you bring to the party

  • Enterprise client leadership: Experience managing complex, enterprise B2B client relationships

  • Transformation mindset: Ability to guide clients through operational and cultural change

  • Technology & product fluency: Strong understanding of SaaS platforms and technical delivery environments

  • Energy & utilities experience (preferred): Experience in utilities, energy retail, or similar industries

  • Executive presence: Trusted advisor to senior leaders; able to influence and challenge constructively

  • Regional and cultural fluency:

    • Fluency in Japanese and English required

    • Strong understanding of Japanese business culture

    • Ability to operate effectively across global and local teams

Our Values

  • At Kraken, we’re guided by:

    • Customer Obsession – We focus relentlessly on client outcomes

    • Freedom & Responsibility – We empower people and expect accountability

    • Get Shit Done – We prioritize action and execution

    • Purple – We stay human, curious, and collaborative

jobs.title: Senior Client Delivery Lead - Markets
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Framework:

Kraken is looking for a Senior Client Delivery Lead to help North American utilities navigate complex technology transformation. Sitting within our Markets Delivery team, you’ll operate at the intersection of clients, product, and engineering, helping solve problems across an evolving energy landscape that includes grid modernization, market operations, and smarter infrastructure.

This is a highly technical, client-facing role. You’ll need to understand how technology fits together, get into the detail of integrations and APIs, and translate complex client requirements into solutions our product and engineering teams can deliver. You’ll own client relationships within your domain, troubleshoot and triage technical challenges, influence priorities, and challenge clients to think differently about how technology can solve their problems.

We’re looking for someone with strong technical delivery or product experience who can comfortably bridge conversations between business and engineering teams. Energy or utility experience is valuable, particularly across markets, DERMS, data, billing, or related domains.

You’ll thrive here if you’re technically curious, comfortable with ambiguity, willing to get hands-on, and confident navigating complex stakeholder environments while keeping delivery moving.

 

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

 

We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like.

You will be joining the client delivery team with Kraken working to support North American clients through their technology transformation journeys, supporting new and long term migration projects.

The Client Delivery Lead has direct responsibility for managing a tech domain (billing, finance, comms..) for our client projects. This is either migrating onto our Kraken platform or managing long term technology requirements. They need to work in partnership with the technology and operational teams at Kraken as well as the client to deliver results for our client’s project or business needs. 

 

The Senior Client Delivery Lead has to really understand how Kraken works, understand problems or requests raised by the client and refine solutions in the best way to leverage existing and new capability. They will bring technology, people and processes together to innovate improvements for our clients. You will also support the client in adapting to ways of working that are aligned to Kraken’s development style. You will work closely with Kraken’s product managers and developers to request development needs and act as a link to the client.

 

There are 9 domains across our Delivery teams, with this opening being with our Markets Delivery Team. The position sits right in the middle of where the industry is heading: grid modernization, smarter infrastructure, evolving market dynamics, and how utilities actually operationalize all of it through technology. The team are looking for someone who understands how the pieces fit together across the broader utility ecosystem and can navigate the complexity that comes with it.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • You will be managing the relationship with client counterparts (often product owners and business owners)

  • You will be the first point of contact for tech development and the escalation and resolution point with customers for specific domain/product issues

  • Being the knowledge base of how Kraken works and how we deliver Kraken Platform

  • Triaging incoming requests and communicating client priorities internally. 

  • Summarizing and articulating client needs, considerations, timelines internally to enable the ongoing development of the Kraken platform.

  • Supporting the engineering team to deliver product features

  • Challenging the client to think differently about tech development, having full belief in the continuous iteration and deployment approach we have.

 

This is a hands-on, individual contributor position. The role is North America based and your projects could be run from any state, travel is expected as part of this role.

 

We are a flat and agile organization and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever changing environment. To thrive here you must be a self-starter and willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem, constantly flexing outside of your typical job role to drive progress for our clients and organization.

 

You must be committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing stakeholders through a journey of change. 

 

You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client. 

 

  • We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. Framework:

Kraken is looking for a Solutions Consultant to become the product and technical expert at the heart of our North American sales team. You’ll work alongside Sales to understand prospective utility clients, translate their challenges into Kraken solutions, and demonstrate how our technology can transform the way they operate and serve their customers.

This is a hands-on role for someone who loves getting deep into a product and then making the complex feel simple. You’ll lead tailored demos and technical conversations, contribute to RFPs, support opportunities throughout the sales cycle, and build strong relationships across product, engineering, and delivery to stay close to what Kraken can do today and where it’s going next.

We’re looking for someone with a strong technology and product mindset, ideally with experience in pre-sales, software delivery, or energy technology. Experience with CIS, MDM, CRM, or utility platforms would be particularly valuable.

You’ll have significant autonomy to develop your expertise, influence major opportunities, and directly contribute to Kraken’s growth in North America while exploring a broad product landscape spanning billing, data, AI, customer experience, and energy.

Kraken Customer

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

🏡 Where you'll fit in

As a Solution Consultant, you will be the technical and product expert who bridges the gap between our cutting-edge solutions and the needs of prospective clients. Working as part of the sales team, you will lead technical discussions, deliver compelling product demonstrations, and showcase how Kraken’s capabilities align with client goals. This is an exciting opportunity for someone with a background in the energy sector or related industries, who thrives on translating complex concepts into clear value propositions. 

  • We distribute opportunities across the team

  • Regional focus - US (east or west coast)

  • Support each other across these opportunities 

  • A lot of collab and support - so never alone

  • Everyone is strong in different areas, wear different hats at different hats - compliment each other = dynamic team 

  • Keen interest in technology without being techy 

  • Passion for learning together and from each other - curiosity and drive to learn new concepts

🚀 What you’ll own

  • Deep Product Expertise: Develop a comprehensive understanding of Kraken’s features, capabilities, and differentiators.

  • Sales Support: Collaborate with the sales team throughout the sales cycle, offering strategic input, technical knowledge, and relationship-building support.

  • Product Demonstrations: Deliver engaging and tailored product demos, workshops, and presentations to highlight Kraken’s unique value proposition.

  • Client Needs Assessment: Engage with clients to identify their challenges and map their needs to Kraken’s solutions.

  • Content Creation: Lead the creation of high-impact sales collateral, including proposals, presentations, and ad hoc materials that emphasise Kraken’s USPs.

  • Technical Queries: Address and resolve functional and technical questions from prospective clients.

  • Tender Responses: Own and contribute to RFPs and tender responses, particularly the functional and technical aspects.

  • Market Research: Conduct market and industry research to enhance prospecting strategies and pre-sales pitch development.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with sales, marketing, and product teams to provide customer insights and influence product roadmaps.

🧠 What you bring to the party

  • Proven experience in a pre-sales, solutions architect, or technical consulting role, ideally within the energy industry.

  • Strong understanding of cloud-based platforms and software solutions.

  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience in software implementation, systems architecture, or business analysis.

  • Proficiency in crafting compelling sales collateral, including proposals and technical documentation.

  • Ability to be resourceful, adaptable, and focused on delivering impactful outcomes

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

Kraken について

 

Kraken は、エネルギー供給会社向けにKrakenプラットフォームをグローバルに提供しています。現在のクライアントは EDF、EON Next、Origin、Plenitude、東京ガス など。これから数年間でさらに多くのクライアントが参加予定です。

 

このポジションで何をするの？

 

現在、日本の大手クライアントでKrakenの導入を進めており、プラットフォーム導入に伴うオペレーション変革＆カルチャー改革をリードするチームを拡大中です。

シニア・クライアント・インプリメンテーション・リードは、クライアントのオペレーティングモデル（「どうやって物事を進めるか」）とオペレーティング環境（実際のカルチャー改革プログラム）を統括。クライアントとのカルチャー改革プログラムのコーディネート・構築・管理・実行まで幅広く担当します。テクノロジーチーム、プロダクトマネージャー、クライアントチームと密接に連携して進めます。

クライアント・インプリメンテーション・リードは、Krakenの働き方を体現し、問題を発見し、解決策を作り、ワークショップやトレーニングを通してクライアントに届けます。テクノロジー、プロセス、人を組み合わせて、クライアントのカルチャー改革をイノベーティブに実現する役割です。

 
 

🚀 主な役割・責務：

 

クライアントのオペレーション変革支援

・シニア・クライアント・インプリメンテーション・リードとして、カルチャー改革プログラムの設計と実行をリード

・Kraken Transformation Directorと連携し、クライアントを変革の旅路に導く

・Kraken Technologiesの実装チームやクライアントと協力して、リーダーシップ開発やコーチングを含むカルチャー改革プログラムを展開

・成功する導入のための計画、タイムライン、リソースを作成

・プロジェクト進捗の管理、問題のエスカレーション、障害の解消

 

ワークショップの提供

・トレーニンググループやリーダーシップ開発向けワークショップの準備と実施

・クライアントのニーズに基づいたオペレーション分析を支援し、それをチーム向けプログラムに落とし込む

 

その他

・出張あり

・曖昧さを楽しみ、主体的に動き、クライアントに直接関わることに喜びを感じる方を求めます

・自由・自律・信頼のもと、シンプルで進化し続けるテクノロジープラットフォームを最大限に活用

・必要であれば自分の担当領域を超えてクライアントを支援する柔軟性

 
 

求める特性：

 

好奇心・主体性

細かいことに気付き、自己学習を楽しめる方。チームがサポートしますが、自分で考え、挑戦できる方にぴったりです。

 

タイムマネジメント

最小限の指示でも独立して作業でき、チームと連携してプロジェクトを進められる方。タスクとクライアントの優先順位を上手に管理できる方。

 

影響力のあるコミュニケーター

Krakenの考え方を自然に伝えられ、ミーティングをリードし、戦略を推進できる方。スライド、ガントチャート、フローチャートを活用して説明できる方。

 

忍耐力

クライアントは大きな変化を経験中。時には進みが遅く感じることもありますが、丁寧に繰り返しサポートできる方。地域ごとの調整や変更にも柔軟に対応できる方。

🧠 必須スキル・経験

  • ビジネストランスフォーメーション / BPRの専門知識

  • ビジネスプロセスリエンジニアリング（BPR）やトランスフォーメーションプロジェクトをリードした実績。

  • 組織のオペレーショナルエクセレンスや効率改善を推進した経験。

 

組織開発（Organizational Development）

  • 組織構造、カルチャー、業務プロセスの最適化に関する専門知識。

  • ビジネス目標に沿った組織能力の強化経験。

 

シニアステークホルダー管理

  • シニアステークホルダーとの関係構築・調整の実績。

  • 組織間の整合性を保ち、効果的なコミュニケーションを推進。

 

プロジェクト・プログラム管理

  • 複雑なプロジェクトやプログラムの管理・実行経験。

  • スコープ、スケジュール、予算内での成果達成に注力。

 

語学要件

  • 日本語ネイティブレベル

  • ビジネスレベルの英語力

Kraken is looking for a Senior Client Delivery Lead to sit at the heart of how utility customers experience their energy provider. Working within our Customer Lifecycles team, you’ll connect client needs, product, engineering, and operational teams to shape and deliver technology that improves the customer journey from move-in to move-out and everything in between.

This is a hands-on client leadership role for someone comfortable navigating complexity, challenging established ways of working, and turning business problems into scalable technology solutions. You’ll build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, influence product priorities, and help teams adopt Kraken’s fast, iterative approach to technology delivery.

We’re looking for someone with strong client delivery or product experience, a solid technical mindset, and exposure to areas such as energy, CRM, customer journeys, billing, or customer operations. Previous people leadership experience is important, but this remains an individual contributor role where you’ll lead through influence and execution.

You’ll have significant scope to shape how we work with clients, strengthen our delivery approach, and contribute to the continued growth of Kraken in North America.

Kraken Customer

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. 
 

You will be joining the client delivery team with Kraken working to support North American clients through their technology transformation journeys, supporting new and long term migration projects. We have openings at 2 levels for this team!

The Client Delivery Lead has direct responsibility for managing a tech domain (billing, finance, comms..) for our client projects. This is either migrating onto our Kraken platform or managing long term technology requirements. They need to work in partnership with the technology and operational teams at Kraken as well as the client to deliver results for our client’s project or business needs. 
 
The Senior Client Delivery Lead has to really understand how Kraken works, understand problems or requests raised by the client and refine solutions in the best way to leverage existing and new capability. They will bring technology, people and processes together to innovate improvements for our clients. You will also support the client in adapting to ways of working that are aligned to Kraken’s development style. You will work closely with Kraken’s product managers and developers to request development needs and act as a link to the client.
 
There are 9 domains across our Delivery teams, with this opening being with our Customer Lifecycles Delivery Team. This position sits at the heart of the customer experience, shaping how millions of utility customers interact with their provider from move-in to move-out and everything in between. The team is looking for someone who can connect people, processes, and technology across the utility ecosystem, navigate ambiguity, and design solutions that improve the customer journey at every stage.

What You'll Do

  • You will be managing the relationship with client counterparts (often product owners and business owners)

  • You will be the first point of contact for tech development and the escalation and resolution point with customers for specific domain/product issues

  • Being the knowledge base of how Kraken works and how we deliver Kraken Platform

  • Triaging incoming requests and communicating client priorities internally. 

  • Summarising and articulating client needs, considerations, timelines internally to enable the ongoing development of the Kraken platform.

  • Supporting the engineering team to deliver product features

  • Challenging the client to think differently about tech development, having full belief in the continuous iteration and deployment approach we have.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor position - with opportunity for leadership formally via line management and leadership expertise expected day-to-day in driving delivery and initiatives across your team & peers, the engineering teams, and the global product teams. The role is North America based and your projects could be run from any state, travel is expected as part of this role.

We are a flat and agile organization and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever changing environment. To thrive here you must be a self-starter and willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem, constantly flexing outside of your typical job role to drive progress for our clients and organization.

You must be committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing stakeholders through a journey of change. 

You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client. 

  • We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you.

What You'll Need

  • At senior level we require relevant domain experience across one of the following areas (Energy, billing systems, CRM, customer journeys, data, DERMS, energy market experience, ERCOT, payments, commercials).

  • Strong agile delivery experience

  • Experience of product management and customer journeys

  • Solid understanding of technology and associated trends

  • Excellent communications, collaboration and presentation skills

  • Strong influencing skills and ability to challenge traditional ways of thinking

  • Experience of working with significant complex delivery pipelines for clients

  • Patience - our clients are undergoing huge transformations that take time and require our understanding 

  • Consulting experience is a plus

  • Regulatory compliance experience is a plus

  • We have a new office in New York City and will need you to be onsite 3+ days a week. There will also be travel to client sites across the country at regular intervals. 

Experience / Qualifications needed:

  • Technical mindset, experience in the energy supply sector and with customer journeys

  • Degree qualified equivalent, with strong client delivery and/or product ownership experience

  • Experience in client facing roles and stakeholder management

  • Experience in managing technical product or projects

  • Exceptional interpersonal skills 

  • Proficient in tools such as Miro and office suite

Culture fit: 

  • Passionate about leading, motivating and developing others 

  • Passionate about helping customers (without them, we don’t exist)

  • Passionate about technology (we are a tech business disrupting energy) 

  • Committed to sustainability (we are all about speeding up the shift to a more sustainable world) 

  • Open minded, flexible and adaptable (we are constantly growing, changing and evolving) 

  • Confident in decision making 

  • Supportive

  • Approachable

  • Inclusive

  • Resilient, working well under pressure 

Why You'll Love it Here

  • Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options including FSAs.

  • Paid time off — we know working hard means also being able to recharge as needed, we trust our employees to get the work done and take the time they need.

  • 401(k) plan with employer match.

  • Parental leave. Biological, adoptive and foster parents are all eligible. 

  • Pre-tax commuter benefits.

  • Flexible working environment: you need to shift around your schedule? You do you, we genuinely believe in work/life balance. 

  • Equity Options: every Kraken employee owns part of the business. We’re a team, working together towards huge goals. Every person is crucial to our success, you should be rewarded as such. 

  • Modern office or co-working spaces depending on location.

  • The salary range for this senior role in NYC ranges on average from $140,000-$200,000 depending on relevant experience, role alignment, and technical/client management expertise demonstrated throughout the interview process. While the broad salary range is listed, not all candidates will be placed at the top of the range—this will be determined by the overall fit for the position. If you have questions about this, just ask! Our recruiters are happy to provide more context.

Kraken is a certified Great Place to Work in France, Germany, Spain, Japan, Australia, and USA. In the UK we are one of the Best Workplaces on Glassdoor with a score of 4.5. Check out our Welcome to the Jungle site (FR/EN) to learn more about our teams and culture.

 

Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at inclusion@kraken.tech. We’ll do our best to tailor the experience to your needs so you can feel comfortable, confident and be at your best!

As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

Kraken’s technology is written and maintained by a multi-discipline engineering team of around 1,400 people globally, which includes server-side, client-side, and mobile engineers. We follow an agile way of working, where individual teams are given the freedom to choose the tools that are most appropriate for managing their work.

Kraken is a great place to learn, work with talented engineers and level-up your skills. Some of our coding conventions are open-source.

This role is available remotely within Australia or hybrid from Melbourne

Our technology

Our backend developers use Python. Most of our websites are powered by Django and GraphQL (Graphene). Our CircleCI CI/CD pipeline runs tens of thousands of tests, deploying into AWS EKS defined by Terraform over 100 times per day and observed with tools like Sentry and Datadog. This allows us to move fast and at scale, without compromising reliability. Teams work differently but the commitment to quality is the same.

Developers at Kraken are empowered to use cutting-edge AI tools and models. Any generated code is still owned by a human.

What we do

Kraken Engineering has multiple disciplinary groups with their own management structures and teams working together to create a unified Kraken that can be deployed to any territory in the world to achieve clients’ goals.

Client Engineering is the development arm responsible for making sure our clients receive the best possible experience and their needs are met with high quality solutions. 

This covers:

  • Implementation: How our core products are configured for the needs of the region, market or client.

  • Acceleration: Improving the core product quickly and iteratively to meet the needs of our clients.

  • Invention: What new solutions could we build to solve requirements that fall out of scope of our existing product offering.

  • Support: Making sure our clients feel supported, responding to incidents, helping client-facing folk with technical discussions and in general being present and visible.

🚀 What you’ll own:

  • Senior Engineers have not only strong engineering skills, but the ability to make cross-team and organizational impacts. 

    • Technical & Architectural Ownership: Build robust, fault-tolerant software using Python, Django, GraphQL, Celery, and PostgreSQL. Apply deep architectural knowledge (e.g., separation of concerns, interfaces and refactoring practices like the Strangler Fig pattern or Chesterton’s Fence) to solve complex domain modeling challenges.

    • Leadership & Execution: Take on large milestones, driving their direction and cadence to consistently hit target dates while managing technical trade-offs.

    • Cross-Domain Bridge: Connect your team with related teams on cross-functional projects, quickly catching up on unfamiliar concepts and identifying critical points across domains.

    • Communication & Risk Management: Articulate technical points clearly across domains and to stakeholders at all levels of technical literacy using a "strong opinions, loosely held" approach.

    • Documentation & Standards: Set standards through your code and actions, ensure features and rollouts are thoroughly documented, and raise the engineering bar across the organization.

    • Mentorship: Sponsor and mentor engineers, helping them grow and reach the standards needed for promotion.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • Python & Django (or equivalent web framework)

  • Domain modeling and architectural design

  • GraphQL

  • Writing robust and fault-tolerant software

  • Celery and async processing

  • PostgreSQL

⭐️Bonus points:

  • AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes

  • Experience with one or more frontend frameworks

💜 What you'll love about us:

  • Flexible working environment - genuine work life balance here, we are in the top 5 companies in the UK, we treat you as a human, and do our best to make work and life merge smoothly together 

  • Equity Options Scheme - you own your own part of the business, share options in Kraken so we all work together towards success 

  • Office - have a certain tech requirement? We’ll do our best to get it. We also have drinks, snacks and a coffee machine at the office space on Bourke street.

  • Your development is important - we support and help with development including internal and external courses, learning, study support etc, all bespoke to you 

Kraken is a certified Great Place to Work in France, Germany, Spain, Japan, Australia, and USA. In the UK we are one of the Best Workplaces on Glassdoor with a score of 4.5. Check out our Welcome to the Jungle site (FR/EN) to learn more about our teams and culture.

Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at inclusion@kraken.tech. We’ll do our best to tailor the experience to your needs so you can feel comfortable, confident and be at your best!

Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. We consider all applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

*Our (i) Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice and Artificial Intelligence (AI) Notice, (ii) Website Privacy Notice and (iii) Cookie Notice govern the collection and use of your personal data in connection with your application and use of our website. These policies explain how we handle your data and outline your rights under applicable laws, including, but not limited to, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your information, object to processing, or withdraw consent. By applying, you acknowledge that you’ve read, understood and consent to these terms
