jobs.title: Senior Client Delivery Lead - Billing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Customer

 

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. 

 

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

 

You will be joining the client delivery team with Kraken working to support European clients through their technology transformation journeys, supporting long term migration projects.

The Client Delivery Lead has direct responsibility managing a tech domain (billing, finance, comms..) for our client projects. This is either migrating onto our Kraken platform or managing long term technology requirements. They need to work in partnership with the technology and operational teams at Kraken as well as the client to deliver results for our client’s project or business needs. 

 

The Client Delivery Lead has to really understand how Kraken works, understand problems or requests raised by the client and refine solutions in the best way to leverage existing and new capability. They will bring technology, people and processes together to innovate improvements for our clients. You will also support the client in adapting to ways of working that are aligned to Kraken’s development style. You will work closely with Kraken’s product managers and developers to request development needs and act as a link to the client.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • You will be managing the relationship with client counterparts (often product owners and business owners)

  • You will be the first point of contact for tech development and the escalation and resolution point with customers for specific domain/product issues

  • Being the knowledge base of how Kraken works and how we deliver Kraken Platform

  • Triaging incoming requests and communicating client priorities internally. 

  • Summarising and articulating client needs, considerations, timelines internally to enable the ongoing development of the Kraken platform.

  • Supporting the engineering team to deliver product features

  • Challenging the client to think differently about tech development, having full belief in the continuous iteration and deployment approach we have.

 

This is a hands-on, individual contributor position. The role is European based and your projects could be run from any country, travel is expected as part of this role.

 

We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever changing environment. To thrive here you must be a self-starter and willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem, constantly flexing outside of your typical job role to drive progress for our clients and organisation.

You must be  committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing stakeholders through a journey of change. 

 

You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client. 

 

We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • In this position you will be laser focused on satisfying our customer’s needs. We are looking for people with strong problem solving skills and a super positive solutions oriented mindset. If you have a taste for raising up to challenges and a winner mindset, this position is the right fit for you! (“Every problem has a solution, facing new challenges is exciting because that’s what makes us better every day and the bigger the challenge, the bigger the feeling of success”)

  • Strong client delivery and/or product ownership experience

  • Agile delivery experience 

  • Experience of product management and customer journeys

  • Solid understanding of technology and associated trends

  • Excellent communications, collaboration and presentation skills

  • Strong influencing skills and ability to challenge traditional ways of thinking

  • Experience of working with significant complex delivery pipelines for clients

  • Patience and initiative - our clients are undergoing huge transformations that take time and require our understanding 

  • Time management and a get-stuff-done attitude

  • Consulting experience is a plus 

  • Fluent English + Danish is required for this role 

If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you.

 

Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at inclusion@kraken.tech. We’ll do our best to tailor the experience to your needs so you can feel comfortable, confident and be at your best!

Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we’re looking for! At Kraken, we're creating a team of genuine, honest, empathetic people. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. We consider all applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

*Our (i) Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice and Artificial Intelligence (AI) Notice, (ii) Website Privacy Notice and (iii) Cookie Notice govern the collection and use of your personal data in connection with your application and use of our website. These policies explain how we handle your data and outline your rights under applicable laws, including, but not limited to, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Working closely with the US GM, Head of Product, and Head of Sales, you'll shape the GTM from the ground up - the right segments, the right positioning, the right moves. It's a role for someone who's as comfortable in a market strategy conversation as they are translating it into how we win deals.

    • Develop recommendations on market entry, positioning and commercial strategy.

    • Define differentiated value propositions and positioning.

    • Partner with Marketing to develop go-to-market content, including sales enablement and customer-facing materials.

    • Bring an outside-in perspective to product and commercial planning.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills.

 

You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. 

 

While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio.

 

When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt.

Key Responsibilities: what you'll do

  • Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement:

  • Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme.

  • Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation.

  • Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions.

  • Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation.

  • Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations.

 

Project Management:

  • Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised.

  • Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track.

  • Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs.

 

Mentorship & Coaching:

  • Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation.

  • Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies.

 

Analytical & Problem-Solving:

  • Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct.

  • Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes.

  • Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence:

  • Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and  Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations.

  • Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration.

  • Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality.

 

Driving Organisational Change:

  • Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach.

  • Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success.

Skills: what you'll have

  • Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions.

  • Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies.

  • Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions.

  • Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience.

  • Fluent English & French is a prerequisite

 

Experience

  • Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level.

  • Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively.

  • Change management using agile methodologies.

  • Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. 

 

Other Requirements:

  • Ability to travel globally, with placement based on preference when possible, but flexibility required according to client needs.

  • You are based in and around Paris and are willing to go to the office 2-3 times per week

  • Ability to work across multiple clients and markets, quickly adapting to varying client needs and environments/languages.

  • Highly driven to ‘make things happen’. Growth mindset demonstrated through all your work. Ability to speak persuasively and inspire energy, motivating both internal teams and external stakeholders including Direct Reports.

  • Comfortable navigating between operations and technical conversations, bridging gaps between business needs and technical solutions.

  • Expertise in driving programme ownership, from inception through to sustainable execution, ensuring clients are equipped to lead post-migration.

Please submit your resume in English 🇬🇧

This position involves travelling across different European countries 🚃.

You may see this role listed as "Client Enablement and Coaching Lead". This is to help the right people find it. The actual job title is Client Delivery Lead.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken is looking for a Senior Client Delivery Lead to help transform how some of North America’s largest utilities operate. Sitting within our Human & Organizational Design Practice, this is a hands-on client leadership role focused on turning ambitious transformation strategies into new ways of working that actually stick.

You’ll work closely with utility leaders and frontline teams during periods of significant change, helping redesign operational processes, build capability, and embed the behaviors needed to get the most from Kraken’s technology. This isn’t traditional consulting: you’ll be on the ground with clients, navigating ambiguity, challenging established thinking, and helping people through complex change.

We’re looking for someone who understands North American utility operations and combines strong client instincts with high emotional intelligence, creativity, and a bias toward action. Consulting experience is valuable, but you’ll need to be someone who rolls up their sleeves rather than simply advising from the sidelines.

It’s an opportunity to have a tangible impact on how utilities operate, how their people experience change, and ultimately how they serve millions of customers. Significant North American travel is expected.

Where you'll fit in:

Kraken's Human and Organizational (H&O) Design Practice exists to help utilities realize the full value of transformation — designing organizations and enabling people to thrive through change. Structured around three disciplines — Organizational Design (OD), Human Design (HD), and Client Delivery Leadership (CDL) — the Practice is building a global blueprint for the Utility of the Future: a repeatable model that reduces cost-to-serve, increases decision velocity, and strengthens alignment across every client we serve.

As a Senior CDL, you are the primary bridge between Kraken's global H&O vision and the day-to-day reality of client transformation in North America. You'll coach utility leaders, stand up and embed operational processes, build client capability, and model the behaviors that make change stick. Guided by simplicity, customer benefit, and efficiency, members of the Kraken H&O team are role models for what great looks like. If you believe in the power of well-designed organizations and great people to reshape an industry, this is the right place for you.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • Your day to day will vary, but here's some insight into the types of things you'll be responsible for:

    Client Leadership & Transformation

    • Champion the Kraken H&O model — be the proof point that it works, and communicate best practices and operating principles to clients with confidence.

    • Lead the human and organizational workstream within client implementations, partnering with OD and HD Leads to deliver a coherent transformation experience.

    • Coach and mentor client leaders 1:1, acting as a trusted advisor during periods of significant change and pushing people to the next level of performance.

    • Support clients in transforming their recruitment and talent practices, leading by example with a lens on reducing bias and championing diversity.

    Program Delivery

    • Design and stand up key operational processes — including workforce scheduling, Skills Academy, and functional workflows tailored to North American utilities.

    • Deliver high-level leadership development programs — including Influential Management, Assertive Communication, and Principled Decision-Making.

    • Produce clear facilitation materials, training content, and slide decks that teach and inspire from frontline teams to senior directors.

    • Analyze performance data and use Excel/Google Sheets to generate insights that drive client decision-making.

    Stakeholder Engagement

    • Communicate and influence effectively, flexing your approach to help resistant stakeholders feel safe, excited, and committed to change.

    • Articulate Kraken's H&O value narrative with confidence — explaining not just what we do, but why it matters for people, performance, and the energy transition.

    • Build and maintain trust-based relationships with senior client stakeholders across North American utilities.

    Practice Contribution

    • Actively contribute to the global H&O Practice — sharing North American insights, co-developing content, and helping evolve the Practice's toolkit.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • Fluent English (written and spoken).

  • Demonstrable experience working within or alongside North American energy utilities — a must for a senior-level role.

  • Understanding of utility operations, including customer operations, workforce management, and operational performance.

  • Ability to understand what success looks like for a client — and to hold that picture through ambiguity and change.

  • A flair for influencing and a natural ability to help clients see and commit to new ways of working.

  • Proven experience building trust-based relationships with senior client stakeholders.

  • Comfort working within a globally distributed team and contributing to a shared practice.

  • Based in or able to work from the New York office; frequent travel across North America required.

  • Right to live and work in the United States.

Why you'll love it here:

  • Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options including FSAs.

  • Paid time off — we know working hard means also being able to recharge as needed, we trust our employees to get the work done and take the time they need.

  • 401(k) plan with employer match.

  • Parental leave. Biological, adoptive and foster parents are all eligible.

  • Pre-tax commuter benefits.

  • Flexible working environment: you need to shift around your schedule? You do you, we genuinely believe in work/life balance.

  • Equity Options: every Kraken employee owns part of the business. We’re a team, working together towards huge goals. Every person is crucial to our success, you should be rewarded as such.

  • Modern office or co-working spaces depending on location.

  • The salary range for this senior role in NYC ranges on average from $150,000-$200,000 depending on relevant experience, role alignment, and technical/client management expertise demonstrated throughout the interview process. While the broad salary range is listed, not all candidates will be placed at the top of the range—this will be determined by the overall fit for the position. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Foundations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

AI is a key investment area for Kraken Technologies. A crucial part of this is building the shared foundations that let every team use AI well and move faster on our mission.

You'll work in AI Foundations. We build the platform that lets teams across Kraken build and run AI agents. Our work covers four areas:

  • Access: connecting people and systems to approved AI models and tools

  • Context: grounding AI in trusted Kraken knowledge, data and systems

  • Enablement: reusable building blocks for AI-powered workflows and products

  • Governance: permissions, safety, quality, cost and visibility across the lifecycle


🏡 Where you'll fit in
We're hiring Senior Software Engineers to join one of our three squads:

  • Context: Build the Kraken-specific knowledge layer to make LLMs useful. This covers our internal AI assistant, a structured "client brain" that captures client context and decisions, and pipelines that collect knowledge from tools like Notion, Slack and GitHub.

  • Tooling: deliver LLMs into people's hands. We run the AI Hub (usage insights, MCP gateway, self-serve and specialist agents), the LiteLLM gateway behind Claude Code, Codex and Claude Desktop, and secure cloud dev boxes for AI-assisted engineering.

  • Evals & Observability: covers skill evals, internal benchmarking, agent safety and guardrails, and observability for live AI runs.

Squads are flexible: when priorities shift, people move. This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor role. With your squad lead and the wider team, you'll own large parts of our platform, turn ideas into production systems, shape architecture decisions and help raise the engineering bar.

👾 What you'll own

  • Build shared AI platform services: Design, build and run Python services that other teams rely on, such as gateways, agent runtimes, knowledge pipelines and eval harnesses.

  • Build and run agents: Work out how agents are triggered, authenticated, monitored and governed across systems like Slack, GitHub, Notion and Asana. Ship both self-serve agents and specialist agents.

  • Ground AI in Kraken context: Collect, structure and serve company knowledge so agents give answers that are correct, current and safe to use.

  • Measure and prove quality: Define meaningful test cases, build evals whose results can be reproduced, and add tracing so we know how AI behaves in real use.

  • Build in safety and governance: Turn permissions, guardrails, budgets and data-access rules into software you can maintain, working with Security and TechOps.

  • Operate in AWS: Deploy and support services on AWS and Kubernetes, and make sound reliability, performance and cost trade-offs.

  • Drive adoption: Work directly with engineers and non-technical teams, run workshops, write clear docs and turn feedback into product.

  • Raise the engineering bar: Review designs and code, mentor others, and create patterns that can be reused across AI Foundations.


🧠 What you bring to the party

  • Strong senior-level software engineering: You have owned complex services end to end, from design through testing, deployment and operation.

  • Deep engineering fundamentals: Good judgement on system design, concurrency, security, testing and architecture trade-offs. Strong production Python.

  • Hands-on LLM and agent experience: You have built real things with LLMs, you know where they fail, and you use AI coding tools every day.

  • Cloud experience: You're comfortable running services in AWS and owning their reliability and scalability.

  • Product sense: You care whether people actually use what you build.

  • Clear communication: You can explain trade-offs to technical and non-technical people and challenge ideas constructively.

  • Learning agility: You pick up new tools and domains quickly in a field that changes every month.


🚀 What success looks like

  • Adoption: You ship platform features that teams across Kraken adopt and rely on.

  • Solid systems: The services you own are observable, secure, scalable and cost-aware.

  • Trust at scale: Teams can build and trust agents without rebuilding the basics.

  • Team impact: You make your squad, and the teams around it, better.


⭐️ Bonus points:

  • AI engineering: Pydantic AI, LiteLLM, LangChain, MCP servers

  • Knowledge and retrieval: RAG, search, embeddings, knowledge graphs

  • Evals and safety: Inspect AI, Ragas, OpenAI Evals, NeMo Guardrails, red teaming

  • Platform: Kubernetes, sandboxed or cloud dev environments, AWS Bedrock

  • Backend: Django

  • Observability: Datadog, OpenTelemetry

Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at inclusion@kraken.tech. We’ll do our best to tailor the experience to your needs so you can feel comfortable, confident and be at your best!

Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we’re looking for! At Kraken, we're creating a team of genuine, honest, empathetic people. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. We consider all applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

*Our (i) Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice and Artificial Intelligence (AI) Notice, (ii) Website Privacy Notice and (iii) Cookie Notice govern the collection and use of your personal data in connection with your application and use of our website. These policies explain how we handle your data and outline your rights under applicable laws, including, but not limited to, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your information, object to processing, or withdraw consent. By applying, you acknowledge that you’ve read, understood and consent to these terms

Please note that, in line with our current recruitment policy, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position; applicants must have the right to work in the country that they're applying to, at the time of application.*

jobs.title: Client Delivery Lead - Kraken Distribution
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

Our team

Members of the Kraken Tech team need to be shining examples and believe in decision making based on simplicity, customer benefit and efficiency. We are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of customers and operations teams in other companies and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for companies, but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. We are fundamentally changing the way that energy companies work. We put customer happiness and cost competitiveness first with great people, technology and ways of working.  

 

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for a brilliant mid-level Client Delivery Lead who has experience working with technical stakeholders (developers, QA, solution architects) within the Australian energy distribution sector. If you love making things better for customers, building great products, working with technology, bringing people together to find solutions, then you’ve come to the right place. 

 

We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for hands-on Client Delivery Leads that can help build our capability across our business with Kraken and other 3rd parties as we continue to grow. Our Delivery Leads are here to solve complex problems with great products. 

 

The Client Delivery Lead needs to always work in partnership with the technology and operational teams at Kraken as well as the client. The Delivery Lead has to really understand how Kraken works, identify problems and refine solutions in the best way to leverage existing and new capability. They will bring technology, people and processes together to innovate improvements for our clients.

 

They will deal with complexity across multiple customer journeys with a variety of customer types and end users.  This person will play a critical role in bringing all the right people together to deliver the roadmap. 

What you'll do

  • Work closely with clients to deliver implementations, enhancements, and strategic support for their use of Kraken

  • Identify new ideas and technology to improve the product

  • Ensure a balance between flexibility for the client and efficiency for the product

  • Support the business with issue resolution for the product

  • Support the engineering teams to deliver product features

  • Ensure we are constantly reviewing and adapting to customer and business needs

What you'll have

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Why This Role is Important

We are looking for a highly credible Program Director to take end-to-end ownership of a highly complex, marquee US utility flexibility deployment. This is a "control room heavy" initiative focused specifically on grid-level needs: consolidating and dispatching supply and demand-side flexible assets, to unlock multiple value streams.

Given the “first of a kind” nature of this program, we are looking for a dynamic individual, with deep understanding of our industry and the ability to span the full gamut of getting things done “hands on” to managing the exec level relationships. This role is about writing the book with us.

You will have full delivery and commercial matrix accountability for making this deployment a massive success. You must possess the grid-operational credibility to effectively lead discussions with senior utility stakeholders and the hands-on operational capability to manage the program mechanics yourself. We need a leader who is comfortable working directly on the execution and building the foundational framework for the program.

🚀 What you'll own

  • Program End-to-End: Be the leader driving the program from day one through implementation and into long-term value realisation. You will directly manage the delivery timelines, decision-making, coordination, and execution.

  • Bridge the Gaps: Act with extreme versatility. Produce the necessary documentation, artefacts, and assets along the way, bridging functional gaps as they emerge to ensure seamless delivery.

  • External Stakeholder Management: Build deep credibility with a highly regulated, major US electric utility. Deepen existing relationships, proactively identify and build new ones across the organization, and navigate the complex operational layers of the utility.

  • Internal Alignment & Leadership: Be the credible cross-functional operator who ensures product, engineering/tech, delivery, and customer-facing teams are perfectly aligned. While no product team will report directly to you, you will have the line of sight and influence necessary to steer vital product and delivery trade-offs.

  • Drive Commercial Success: Hold explicit commercial ownership alongside delivery. You will be accountable for the business case, value realization, customer expansion, and revenue linkage.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

  • Experience: In-depth, senior-level experience with target seniority at the Director, Senior Director, or Head-of level in program, implementation, delivery, or utility-transformation leadership.

  • Grid & Flexibility Expertise: Direct, deep experience in grid modernisation programs. You should have a strong understanding of Demand Response, DERs, VPPs, DERMS, AMI, and grid operations.

  • Utility Navigation: Proven experience managing regulated US electric-utility stakeholders. You know how to navigate the operational, control-room side of a utility.

  • Hands-on Operator: Recent end-to-end ownership of a complex grid program (planning, governance, cross-functional execution) where you drove the core project management rather than delegating it to a separate PMO layer.

  • Commercial Acumen: Clear history of commercial/solution ownership, P&L exposure, or value realisation accountability.

Bonus Points

  • Location/Network: Based on the US East Coast, with specific exposure to Virginia, Mid-Atlantic, or broader East Coast utility ecosystems.

  • Niche Expertise: Experience leading grid-side flexibility work aimed at specific physical or locational grid constraints, rather than just bulk system or generic programs.

  • Industry Presence: A recognized and credible figure in the US utility or flexibility ecosystem.

  • Travel: this role will involve travel to the client in the North East every ~2 weeks for a few days at a time.

⭐️ Why you'll love it here:

  • Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options including FSAs.

  • Paid time off — we know working hard means also being able to recharge as needed, we trust our employees to get the work done and take the time they need.

  • 401(k) plan with employer match.

  • Parental leave. Biological, adoptive and foster parents are all eligible.

  • Pre-tax commuter benefits.

  • Flexible working environment: you need to shift around your schedule? You do you, we genuinely believe in work/life balance.

  • Equity Options: every Kraken employee owns part of the business. We’re a team, working together towards huge goals. Every person is crucial to our success, you should be rewarded as such.

  • Modern office or co-working spaces depending on location.

  • The salary range for this position is from $200,000 - $260,000 depending on relevant experience, role alignment, and client management expertise demonstrated throughout the interview process. While the broad salary range is listed, not all candidates will be placed at the top of the range—this will be determined by the overall fit for the position. jobs.descriptionHtml:

From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills.

 

You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. 

 

While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio.

 

When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt.

Key Responsibilities: what you'll do

  • Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement:

  • Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme.

  • Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation.

  • Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions.

  • Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation.

  • Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations.

 

Project Management:

  • Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised.

  • Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track.

  • Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs.

 

Mentorship & Coaching:

  • Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation.

  • Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies.

 

Analytical & Problem-Solving:

  • Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct.

  • Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes.

  • Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence:

  • Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and  Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations.

  • Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration.

  • Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality.

 

Driving Organisational Change:

  • Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach.

  • Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success.

Skills: what you'll have

  • Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions.

  • Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies.

  • Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions.

  • Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience.

 

Experience

  • Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level.

  • Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively.

  • Change management using agile methodologies.

  • Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. 

 

Other Requirements:

  • Ability to travel globally, with placement based on preference when possible, but flexibility required according to client needs.

  • You are based in and around Berlin and are willing to go to the office 2-3 times per week

  • Ability to work across multiple clients and markets, quickly adapting to varying client needs and environments/languages.

  • Highly driven to ‘make things happen’. Growth mindset demonstrated through all your work. Ability to speak persuasively and inspire energy, motivating both internal teams and external stakeholders including Direct Reports.

  • Comfortable navigating between operations and technical conversations, bridging gaps between business needs and technical solutions.

  • Expertise in driving programme ownership, from inception through to sustainable execution, ensuring clients are equipped to lead post-migration.

  • Fluent German & English is a prerequisite for this role

Please submit your resume in English 🇬🇧

This position involves travelling across different European countries 🚃

You may see this role listed as "Client Enablement and Coaching Lead". This is to help the right people find it. The actual job title is Client Delivery Lead.

jobs.descriptionPlain:

Kraken https://kraken.tech/ powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.



What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills.

 

You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. 

 

While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio.

 

When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt.

Key Responsibilities: what you'll do

 - Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement:

 - Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme.

 - Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation.

 - Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions.

 - Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation.

 - Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations.

 

Project Management:

 - Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised.

 - Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track.

 - Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs.

 

Mentorship & Coaching:

 - Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation.

 - Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies.

 

Analytical & Problem-Solving:

 - Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct.

 - Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes.

 - Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence:

 - Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and  Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations.

 - Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration.

 - Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality.

 

Driving Organisational Change:

 - Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach.

 - Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success.
   
   

Skills: what you'll have

 - Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines.

 - Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions.

 - Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies.

 - Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions.

 - Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience.

 

Experience

 - Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level.

 - Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively.

 - Change management using agile methodologies.

 - Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. 

 

Other Requirements:

 - Ability to travel globally, with placement based on preference when possible, but flexibility required according to client needs.

 - You are based in and around Berlin and are willing to go to the office 2-3 times per week

 - Ability to work across multiple clients and markets, quickly adapting to varying client needs and environments/languages.

 - Highly driven to ‘make things happen’. Growth mindset demonstrated through all your work. Ability to speak persuasively and inspire energy, motivating both internal teams and external stakeholders including Direct Reports.

 - Comfortable navigating between operations and technical conversations, bridging gaps between business needs and technical solutions.

 - Expertise in driving programme ownership, from inception through to sustainable execution, ensuring clients are equipped to lead post-migration.

 - Fluent German & English is a prerequisite for this role

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

At Kraken we’re looking to revolutionise the energy system to make power cheaper, greener and better for people around the world. Our tech platform is already licensed to support 60 million customer accounts in 17 countries, and we aim to serve 100 million globally by 2027.

Our technology team has grown extremely quickly as a result. With this rapid growth, we are looking for Platform Engineers to join our team.

The data platform team works across the whole customer domain, handling everything from natural language understanding of our customer communications to processing billions of smart meter readings every day to support clients in creating customised and market leading smart energy tariffs.

As the volume, scope, and geographical range of our data offerings rapidly expand, we're looking for an experienced Platform Engineer to join the team to help us build and maintain our platform, pipelines and data sources.

We're passionate about building great technology to change the way customers use, and think about, energy for the good of the planet. This is a fantastic opportunity to work with us on data problems that genuinely move us closer to Net Zero, and support the energy transition.

We employ software engineering best practices to design, test, and deploy our data platform and services.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering - Optimisation & Control
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in:
KrakenFlex is the flexibility arm of the Kraken group, built to put a big green dent in global carbon emissions by rewriting how electricity grids operate. We stabilize the grid and help renewables come online much faster by managing the second-by-second balance of clean power. Right now, our platform connects nearly one million assets worldwide, putting over 6GW of live load under our direct control.

Behind the scenes, that means handling massive technical scale: solving complex optimization problems in real time and processing 15 billion data readings a day from the latest green technologies, ensuring the grid stays reliable without relying on old fossil-fuel backup plants.

The next phase of our journey involves monumental growth. Currently operational across multiple countries, we are poised for further global expansion, scaling our asset base and tackling unique grid challenges in new territories. Our mission is to integrate an increasingly diverse array of green flexibility assets while ensuring our market-leading platform remains exceptionally stable and performant.

What is Optimisation in Flex?
The Optimisation chapter is the mathematical and algorithmic engine of the KrakenFlex platform. While other chapters manage physical asset connectivity or ingest market signals, this domain is responsible for the intelligence that decides exactly what every asset should do, second by second, to maximise both grid stability and financial returns.

The teams within this chapter build and maintain the real-time dispatch engines, predictive forecasting models, and algorithmic solvers that handle massive multi-asset portfolios. This involves translating complex market rules, physical asset constraints (like battery degradation curves, state-of-charge limits, and ramp rates), and fluctuating price signals into optimised execution strategies.

The defining challenge for this chapter is scaling computational performance alongside our rapid asset growth. Running complex, multi-variable mathematical models in tight real-time windows requires immense efficiency. The core tension lies in balancing the demand from data science and quantitative engineering to introduce increasingly sophisticated models with the strict platform requirement for absolute reliability, low latency, and cost-effective cloud compute.

Ultimately, this chapter must move away from bespoke optimisation routines tailored to individual markets or asset types. Your goal is to architect a highly performant, modular optimisation core that uses standard abstract layers, allowing us to roll out new algorithms or expand into new global territories without rewriting the underlying engine.

🚀 What you’ll own:
The Flex platform is built on autonomous Chapters, which are collections of specialists focused on delivering a core service or business outcome, defined by the unchanging nature of the energy business (independent of technology, hardware, or regional differences). A Head of Engineering leading a Chapter is a senior leadership role combining strong product thinking, engineering judgement, operational awareness, and people leadership. They manage managers and senior individual contributors, helping teams own their product surfaces, make sound trade-offs, and deliver reliably.

This role requires influencing beyond its formal remit, spotting cross-team patterns, clarifying ownership and decision-making, and driving initiatives to turn recurring issues into visible actions with owners, dates, and measures of success. Ultimately, they maintain the technical vision for their specific area, ensuring services are appropriately owned, maintained, and aligned with Flex's sustainable growth.

  • Managing the leads.

  • Maintaining the technical vision for a given area.

  • The overall team architecture

  • Ensuring the services in that area are owned and maintained appropriately.

  • Ensuring that product features are built in a way that scales, is cost-effective, and is in line with the vision for a product area.

  • Ensuring the appropriate level of quality and resilience, with a specific focus on reducing system incidents and improving stability.

  • Ensuring appropriate tech debt is prioritised to support sustainable delivery.

  • Potentially managing a squad (team) as well.

🧠 What you’ll bring to the party:
You’ll be a strong fit if you have experience leading engineering teams across multiple squads, teams or product areas in a complex product environment.

  • A collaborative product and engineering mindset: you care about customer outcomes, product strategy, technical quality and the people needed to make the work real.

  • Strong judgement in ambiguity: you can separate urgent from important, make trade-offs explicit and help teams move without pretending all uncertainty has disappeared.

  • A track record of influencing beyond your reporting line and team, building trust with senior stakeholders and helping teams reach decisions when ownership is shared.

  • A bias for action and improvement: when you see a recurring issue, you turn it into the smallest useful action that starts making the system better.

  • Reliability in driving initiatives: people can trust that when you take ownership, the work keeps moving, dependencies are managed and decisions are followed through.

  • Strong people leadership practice, including coaching, direct feedback, performance management, delegation, psychological safety and development of future leaders.

jobs.title: Client Delivery Lead - Ops
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken is looking for a Client Delivery Lead to help transform how some of North America’s largest utilities operate. Sitting within our Human & Organizational Design Practice, this is a hands-on client leadership role focused on turning ambitious transformation strategies into new ways of working that actually stick.

You’ll work closely with utility leaders and frontline teams during periods of significant change, helping redesign operational processes, build capability, and embed the behaviors needed to get the most from Kraken’s technology. This isn’t traditional consulting: you’ll be on the ground with clients, navigating ambiguity, challenging established thinking, and helping people through complex change.

We’re looking for someone who understands North American utility operations and combines strong client instincts with high emotional intelligence, creativity, and a bias toward action. Consulting experience is valuable, but you’ll need to be someone who rolls up their sleeves rather than simply advising from the sidelines.

It’s an opportunity to have a tangible impact on how utilities operate, how their people experience change, and ultimately how they serve millions of customers. Significant North American travel is expected.

Where you'll fit in:

Kraken's Human and Organizational (H&O) Design Practice exists to help utilities realize the full value of transformation — designing organizations and enabling people to thrive through change. Structured around three disciplines — Organizational Design (OD), Human Design (HD), and Client Delivery Leadership (CDL) — the Practice is building a global blueprint for the Utility of the Future: a repeatable model that reduces cost-to-serve, increases decision velocity, and strengthens alignment across every client we serve.

As a CDL, you are the primary bridge between Kraken's global H&O vision and the day-to-day reality of client transformation in North America. You'll coach utility leaders, stand up and embed operational processes, build client capability, and model the behaviors that make change stick. Guided by simplicity, customer benefit, and efficiency, members of the Kraken H&O team are role models for what great looks like. If you believe in the power of well-designed organizations and great people to reshape an industry, this is the right place for you.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • Your day to day will vary, but here's some insight into the types of things you'll be responsible for:

    Client Leadership & Transformation

    • Champion the Kraken H&O model — be the proof point that it works, and communicate best practices and operating principles to clients with confidence.

    • Lead the human and organizational workstream within client implementations, partnering with OD and HD Leads to deliver a coherent transformation experience.

    • Coach and mentor client leaders 1:1, acting as a trusted advisor during periods of significant change and pushing people to the next level of performance.

    • Support clients in transforming their recruitment and talent practices, leading by example with a lens on reducing bias and championing diversity.

    Program Delivery

    • Design and stand up key operational processes — including workforce scheduling, Skills Academy, and functional workflows tailored to North American utilities.

    • Deliver high-level leadership development programs — including Influential Management, Assertive Communication, and Principled Decision-Making.

    • Produce clear facilitation materials, training content, and slide decks that teach and inspire from frontline teams to senior directors.

    • Analyze performance data and use Excel/Google Sheets to generate insights that drive client decision-making.

    Stakeholder Engagement

    • Communicate and influence effectively, flexing your approach to help resistant stakeholders feel safe, excited, and committed to change.

    • Articulate Kraken's H&O value narrative with confidence — explaining not just what we do, but why it matters for people, performance, and the energy transition.

    • Build and maintain trust-based relationships with senior client stakeholders across North American utilities.

    Practice Contribution

    • Actively contribute to the global H&O Practice — sharing North American insights, co-developing content, and helping evolve the Practice's toolkit.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • Fluent English (written and spoken).

  • Demonstrable experience working within or alongside North American energy utilities

  • Understanding of utility operations, including customer operations, workforce management, and operational performance.

  • Ability to understand what success looks like for a client and to hold that picture through ambiguity and change.

  • A flair for influencing and a natural ability to help clients see and commit to new ways of working.

  • Proven experience building trust-based relationships with senior client stakeholders.

  • Comfort working within a globally distributed team and contributing to a shared practice.

  • Based in or able to work from the New York office; frequent travel across North America required.

  • Right to live and work in the United States.

Why you'll love it here:

  • Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options including FSAs.

  • Paid time off — we know working hard means also being able to recharge as needed, we trust our employees to get the work done and take the time they need.

  • 401(k) plan with employer match.

  • Parental leave. Biological, adoptive and foster parents are all eligible.

  • Pre-tax commuter benefits.

  • Flexible working environment: you need to shift around your schedule? You do you, we genuinely believe in work/life balance.

  • Equity Options: every Kraken employee owns part of the business. We’re a team, working together towards huge goals. Every person is crucial to our success, you should be rewarded as such.

  • Modern office or co-working spaces depending on location.

  • The salary range for this senior role in NYC ranges on average from $70,000-$140,000 depending on relevant experience, role alignment, and technical/client management expertise demonstrated throughout the interview process. While the broad salary range is listed, not all candidates will be placed at the top of the range—this will be determined by the overall fit for the position. If you have questions about this, just ask! Our recruiters are happy to provide more context.

If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at inclusion@kraken.tech. You’ll work closely with utility leaders and frontline teams during periods of significant change, helping redesign operational processes, build capability, and embed the behaviors needed to get the most from Kraken’s technology. This isn’t traditional consulting: you’ll be on the ground with clients, navigating ambiguity, challenging established thinking, and helping people through complex change.

We’re looking for someone who understands North American utility operations and combines strong client instincts with high emotional intelligence, creativity, and a bias toward action. Consulting experience is valuable, but you’ll need to be someone who rolls up their sleeves rather than simply advising from the sidelines.

🏡 Where you'll fit in:

Work directly with clients. Seek to understand. Be an expert on our platform. Know where to configure vs build to close a gap. Own the build and delivery of the outcome. See it through from end to end.

We’re building a small team in New York to close the gap between the needs of our clients and delivering their needs.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a coordination role. You’ll have the ownership and responsibilities of a software engineer, alongside ownership of a client relationship. You have the ability to work confidently with clients and guide them through unfamiliar territory. That means leading discovery sessions, asking open questions and seeking to understand. You will build a deep platform knowledge in order to make sound technical decisions, build and ship those solutions, triage and fix issues and following through to make sure it delivered the outcome the client needed. You own this from end to end.

Expect a high pace environment, evolving approaches and problems without solutions. We’re looking for people who enjoy ambiguity and making progress in that environment.

🚀 What you’ll own:

  • Build client relationships. You will understand how clients actually work, working directly with operational teams and stakeholders to uncover friction, question assumptions and distinguish symptoms from root causes.

  • Lead the client conversation. Build trust, demonstrate ideas early and challenge requests constructively. Help clients adopt Kraken’s capabilities and ways of working, recognising when changing a process is a better answer than building custom software.

  • Turn unclear problems into buildable solutions. Investigate workflows, systems and data. Develop options, explain trade-offs and establish a practical path forward.

  • Build and ship. Start with Kraken’s existing capabilities and configuration, and design, implement, test and release production software where changes are needed. Build solutions that fit the platform rather than create unnecessary client-specific complexity.

  • Work agent-first. Use agents as a core part of investigation, development and testing. Give them useful context, direct their work and critically assess the results. You remain accountable for what ships.

  • Own the outcome beyond deployment. Make sure the solution works in practice, support adoption and verify that it addresses the original problem.

  • Work across Kraken. Partner with client engineering, delivery and product teams to decide whether a problem is best addressed through existing capabilities, a targeted change or the broader product roadmap. Bring in specialist expertise and balance immediate client needs with the long-term direction of the platform.

  • Extend the impact. Recognise when a solution can benefit other clients, and help turn successful approaches into reusable capabilities and ways of working.

🧠 What you’ll bring to the party:

  • Strong software engineering experience. You’ve independently delivered and maintained production software, and can navigate unfamiliar codebases, review changes and make sound technical decisions.

  • Demonstrated client-facing skills. You’ve worked directly with clients, led discovery or solution discussions, and explained technical choices to both engineering and non-technical audiences.

  • Practical problem-solving ability. You can take a messy operational problem, investigate what matters and build an effective solution without waiting for a complete specification.

  • An agent-first approach to building. You can use coding agents and AI-enabled tools effectively while applying your own engineering judgement to their outputs.

  • Ownership and follow-through. You take responsibility for whether your work solves the problem, not just whether the code is merged.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and pace. You make progress with incomplete information, test assumptions early and know when to move quickly or investigate further.

  • A collaborative engineering mindset. You work constructively with existing teams and build solutions others can understand, operate and maintain.

  • Patience and an ability to explain complex things in a simple way.

The focus of this team

Its focus is significant operational problems where investigation, inventive thinking and hands-on engineering can unlock meaningful improvements. You may work across different workstreams as priorities evolve. Owning the solution does not mean doing everything yourself, but it does mean staying accountable through to a working result.

Bonus points:

We'd be particularly excited if you bring one or more of the following:

  • Experience in energy, utilities, or billing and switching in regulated markets.

  • Experience with incident response or on-call for production systems.

  • A prior forward deployed engineer or customer-facing engineering role.

  • A track record of building internal tools or integrations that teams adopted.

  • Evidence of cutting handoffs or rework in a delivery process.
