jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

Kraken Distribution is building a native analytics capability to support our products, customer migrations and growing customer base. As our first Senior Analytics Engineer in Distribution, you will establish the data models, datasets and working practices that allow our teams and customers to generate trusted insights from Kraken data.

You will be embedded within the Distribution team and work closely with Product, Engineering and Client Delivery Leads to understand customer needs and translate them into scalable analytics capabilities. You will report through the Distribution organisation, with a dotted-line relationship into Kraken’s central Analytics and Data Platform teams. This structure ensures that Distribution priorities drive your work while keeping you connected to Kraken’s wider data community, standards and technical direction.

🚀 What you’ll own:

This is a senior, hands-on role with significant scope to shape how analytics is delivered across Kraken Distribution. You will develop a deep understanding of the global Kraken application data model and the Distribution domain, build curated data models and lightweight ingestion pipelines, and create the documentation and foundations required to support future reporting, analytics and advanced insights.

Kraken Analytics will provide alignment on modelling standards and analytics architecture, while Data Platform will continue to own the foundational platform and shared data infrastructure. You will own Distribution-specific analytics models, datasets, ingestion workflows and data products, working closely with both teams to reuse and extend Kraken’s shared capabilities.

  • Establish and shape the analytics engineering capability within Kraken Distribution to accelerate customer onboarding and support a growing customer base.

  • Become a subject-matter expert in the global Kraken application data model and the Distribution domain, enabling teams and customers to interpret and use Kraken data confidently.

  • Define, build and document reusable data models that make complex Distribution data easier to understand, govern and apply across customer use cases.

  • Partner with Client Delivery Leads, Product, Engineering and customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into scalable data products and analytics capabilities.

  • Support customer migrations through data discovery, mapping, transformation and reconciliation, reducing delivery risk and helping customers realise value sooner.

  • Build and maintain reliable dbt models, shared metrics and core datasets that support consistent operational, product and customer decision-making.

  • Develop lightweight Python-based ingestion pipelines for Distribution-specific market and non-application data, expanding the information available for reporting and advanced insights.

  • Establish automated testing, monitoring, documentation and data-quality controls so that internal teams and customers can use Distribution data with confidence.

  • Select and build effective ways to deliver insights (including trusted datasets, reports, dashboards and data applications) so stakeholders can turn data into action.

  • Collaborate with Kraken Analytics, Data Platform and the wider data community to reuse shared capabilities, avoid duplication and ensure Distribution’s needs contribute to Kraken’s broader data roadmap.

 

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

We are looking for a senior analytics engineer who combines strong technical judgement with the ability to operate autonomously in a complex, customer-facing environment.

You will be comfortable turning ambiguous business and domain problems into well-designed, reliable data products. You can move between detailed, hands-on engineering work and higher-level conversations about customer needs, architecture and priorities. You are also able to influence stakeholders and establish effective ways of working without relying on formal authority.

As the first person in this role, you will be motivated by the opportunity to create something new, while recognising when to reuse and build upon the standards, tools and expertise that already exist across Kraken.

Essential Experience

  • Demonstrated analytics engineering or related data experience, including ownership of complex work from discovery through to production.

  • Advanced SQL and dbt skills, supported by strong data-modelling principles and experience building maintainable, well-tested and reusable models.

  • Experience building production-quality data pipelines using Python and modern cloud data warehouse or lakehouse technologies.

  • Strong engineering practices, including version control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD and an understanding of data quality and reliability.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across Product, Engineering, Analytics and client-facing teams, explaining complex data concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Ability to work autonomously, navigate ambiguity and influence others while balancing immediate delivery with maintainability, scalability and reuse.

We run a modern cloud data platform using key technologies such as:

  • Postgres source databases

  • AWS cloud infrastructure

  • Databricks Delta Lake for data lake and warehouse storage and querying

  • DBT for data modelling and transformations

  • Python as main scripting language

  • Airflow for task scheduling

  • Kubernetes for orchestration

  • Github, Circle CI for version control, deployment and monitoring

 

⭐️Bonus points:

  • Experience in energy, utilities or other regulated industries

  • Experience supporting customer data migrations, system implementations or enterprise transformation programmes.

  • Familiarity with AWS, Airflow, Kubernetes and CircleCI.

 

💜 What you'll love about us:

  • Flexible working environment - genuine work life balance here, we are in the top 5 companies in the UK, we treat you as a human, and do our best to make work and life merge smoothly together

  • Equity Options Scheme - you own your own part of the business, share options in Kraken so we all work together towards success

  • Office - have a certain tech requirement? We’ll do our best to get it. We also have drinks, snacks and a coffee machine at the office space on Bourke street.

  • Your development is important - we support and help with development including internal and external courses, learning, study support etc, all bespoke to you

Kraken is a certified Great Place to Work in France, Germany, Spain, Japan, Australia, and USA. In the UK we are one of the Best Workplaces on Glassdoor with a score of 4.5.

You will be embedded within the Distribution team and work closely with Product, Engineering and Client Delivery Leads to understand customer needs and translate them into scalable analytics capabilities. You will report through the Distribution organisation, with a dotted-line relationship into Kraken’s central Analytics and Data Platform teams. This structure ensures that Distribution priorities drive your work while keeping you connected to Kraken’s wider data community, standards and technical direction.





🚀 WHAT YOU’LL OWN:

You will develop a deep understanding of the global Kraken application data model and the Distribution domain, build curated data models and lightweight ingestion pipelines, and create the documentation and foundations required to support future reporting, analytics and advanced insights.

Kraken Analytics will provide alignment on modelling standards and analytics architecture, while Data Platform will continue to own the foundational platform and shared data infrastructure. You will own Distribution-specific analytics models, datasets, ingestion workflows and data products, working closely with both teams to reuse and extend Kraken’s shared capabilities.

 - Establish and shape the analytics engineering capability within Kraken Distribution to accelerate customer onboarding and support a growing customer base.

 - Become a subject-matter expert in the global Kraken application data model and the Distribution domain, enabling teams and customers to interpret and use Kraken data confidently.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in:

Work directly with clients. Seek to understand. Be an expert on our platform. Know where to configure vs build to close a gap. Own the build and delivery of the outcome. See it through from end to end.

We’re building a small team in New York to close the gap between the needs of our clients and delivering their needs.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a coordination role. You’ll have the ownership and responsibilities of a software engineer, alongside ownership of a client relationship. You have the ability to work confidently with clients and guide them through unfamiliar territory. That means leading discovery sessions, asking open questions and seeking to understand. You will build a deep platform knowledge in order to make sound technical decisions, build and ship those solutions, triage and fix issues and following through to make sure it delivered the outcome the client needed. You own this from end to end.

Expect a high pace environment, evolving approaches and problems without solutions. We’re looking for people who enjoy ambiguity and making progress in that environment.

🚀 What you’ll own:

  • Build client relationships. You will understand how clients actually work, working directly with operational teams and stakeholders to uncover friction, question assumptions and distinguish symptoms from root causes.

  • Lead the client conversation. Build trust, demonstrate ideas early and challenge requests constructively. Help clients adopt Kraken’s capabilities and ways of working, recognising when changing a process is a better answer than building custom software.

  • Turn unclear problems into buildable solutions. Investigate workflows, systems and data. Develop options, explain trade-offs and establish a practical path forward.

  • Build and ship. Start with Kraken’s existing capabilities and configuration, and design, implement, test and release production software where changes are needed. Build solutions that fit the platform rather than create unnecessary client-specific complexity.

  • Work agent-first. Use agents as a core part of investigation, development and testing. Give them useful context, direct their work and critically assess the results. You remain accountable for what ships.

  • Own the outcome beyond deployment. Make sure the solution works in practice, support adoption and verify that it addresses the original problem.

  • Work across Kraken. Partner with client engineering, delivery and product teams to decide whether a problem is best addressed through existing capabilities, a targeted change or the broader product roadmap. Bring in specialist expertise and balance immediate client needs with the long-term direction of the platform.

  • Extend the impact. Recognise when a solution can benefit other clients, and help turn successful approaches into reusable capabilities and ways of working.

🧠 What you’ll bring to the party:

  • Strong software engineering experience. You’ve independently delivered and maintained production software, and can navigate unfamiliar codebases, review changes and make sound technical decisions.

  • Demonstrated client-facing skills. You’ve worked directly with clients, led discovery or solution discussions, and explained technical choices to both engineering and non-technical audiences.

  • Practical problem-solving ability. You can take a messy operational problem, investigate what matters and build an effective solution without waiting for a complete specification.

  • An agent-first approach to building. You can use coding agents and AI-enabled tools effectively while applying your own engineering judgement to their outputs.

  • Ownership and follow-through. You take responsibility for whether your work solves the problem, not just whether the code is merged.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and pace. You make progress with incomplete information, test assumptions early and know when to move quickly or investigate further.

  • A collaborative engineering mindset. You work constructively with existing teams and build solutions others can understand, operate and maintain.

  • Patience and an ability to explain complex things in a simple way.

The focus of this team

Its focus is significant operational problems where investigation, inventive thinking and hands-on engineering can unlock meaningful improvements. You may work across different workstreams as priorities evolve. Owning the solution does not mean doing everything yourself, but it does mean staying accountable through to a working result.

Bonus points:

We'd be particularly excited if you bring one or more of the following:

  • Experience in energy, utilities, or billing and switching in regulated markets.

  • Experience with incident response or on-call for production systems.

  • A prior forward deployed engineer or customer-facing engineering role.

  • A track record of building internal tools or integrations that teams adopted.

  • Evidence of cutting handoffs or rework in a delivery process.

⭐️ Why you'll love it here:

  • Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options including FSAs.

  • Paid time off — we know working hard means also being able to recharge as needed, we trust our employees to get the work done and take the time they need.

  • 401(k) plan with employer match.

  • Parental leave. Biological, adoptive and foster parents are all eligible.

  • Pre-tax commuter benefits.

  • Flexible working environment: you need to shift around your schedule? You do you, we genuinely believe in work/life balance.

  • Equity Options: every Kraken employee owns part of the business. We’re a team, working together towards huge goals. Every person is crucial to our success, you should be rewarded as such.

  • Modern office or co-working spaces depending on location.

  • The salary range for this role in NYC ranges on average from $140,000-$220,000 depending on relevant experience, role alignment, and technical/client management expertise demonstrated throughout the interview process. While the broad salary range is listed, not all candidates will be placed at the top of the range—this will be determined by the overall fit for the position. If you have questions about this, just ask! Our recruiters are happy to provide more context.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

KrakenFlex
The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves to be at the heart of that change.

Our aim is to be the leading global provider of solutions that enable customers to release £30bn of value per annum from distributed energy resources (DERs). We are building a Software as a Service (SaaS) subscription business with a global addressable market of £2.4 billion per annum, by digitally connecting hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets.

We have already attained a market leading position and KrakenFlex is a recognised thought leader and innovator in the industry.

We're looking for a skilled and pragmatic Lead Platform, DevOps, or Cloud Infrastructure engineer to join and help lead our growing team.

Specifically, we're looking for a Lead Platform Engineer to manage a team of 5-8 Platform Engineers and help us build and scale Kraken's AWS cloud foundation, which forms the basis for our market-leading grid flexibility and customer management products. We're an innovative and customer-focussed company, helping to drag the utilities industry into the 21st century, using a mixture of serverless and containerised technologies in AWS.

🚀 What you’ll own

  • Have ownership of a functional team within Platform Engineering, working closely with the Director and Heads of Platform Engineering to define strategic objectives and team direction

  • Own the production stability and reliability of the team’s services, ensuring they are built to scale and operate effectively in production

  • Manage team priorities and deliveries

  • Collaborate regularly and effectively with Platform Engineers in your functional team to deliver the technical implementation of the team’s strategic priorities, working alongside the Product Manager.

  • Lead delivery of major initiatives on clear timelines

  • Partner effectively in the wider Platform Engineering team to deliver outcomes

  • Build a strong culture of open communication where teammates can ask questions without fear, promoting a positive and inclusive team environment.

  • Live the Kraken culture and values, and be a role model for your team

  • Line-manage a group of Platform engineers

  • Set clear performance expectations and goals for team members

  • Regularly review individual and team performance, offering actionable insights and constructive feedback to support and grow team members

  • Deliver technical improvements such as small features and bug fixes, as well as larger projects with the team

  • Support team delivery through code reviews, technology research and architectural guidance

  • Drive and improve the non-functional elements of production systems owned by your team

🧠 What you’ll bring to the party

  • Great experience with AWS. We use a lot of different AWS services and not just the standard few, so you should be comfortable with serverless, managed, and containerised services.

  • Record of successfully and consistently delivering critical path projects, on time and at scale

  • Excellent communication, with a focus on doing this asynchronously across multiple timezones and countries

  • Meticulous organisation and planning skills

  • Experience of mentoring and coaching a team to perform at a high-level of quality

  • Experience managing and supporting large-scale internet-facing distributed systems, for millions of customers

  • Knowledge of security best-practices, security and CI/CD tooling, and methodologies

⭐️ Bonus points

  • Previous experience in leading technical delivery for small, highly-autonomous teams

  • Track-record of effective collaboration with other teams and departments to drive holistic outcomes

  • A proactive, innovative mindset with the ability to drive continuous improvement

  • Previous experience working in a remote-first asynchronous team providing 24x7 support

  • Familiarity with some of our tech stack:

  • Typescript, python, or similar programming languages

  • Terraform, or a similar infrastructure-as-code tool

  • AWS services such as Lambda, IAM, EventBridge/SQS/SNS, DynamoDB, ECS, EKS

  • Messaging queues, event-driven async processing or similar technologies

  • Docker and Kubernetes

  • Experience with Linux

Eng I candidates are earlier in their backend careers. You will have more structured support and guidance as you build confidence, learn our large codebase and develop your technical career.

We hire Engineers who have the skills and drive to keep growing. In this role, you will:

For Eng II candidates, you will additionally:

  • Feature Ownership & Observability: Confidently own and deliver medium-sized engineering problems, address system observability gaps, and manage technical escalations independently.

  • Mentorship & Leadership: Mentor junior engineers, assist with onboarding new team members, and participate in hiring debriefs to help grow the engineering team.

  • Cross-Domain Collaboration: Work confidently across domains to explain technical work, promote best engineering practices (performance, security, testability), and help brainstorm solutions.

  • GraphQL

  • Writing robust and fault-tolerant software

  • PostgreSQL

🏡 Where you'll fit in

You'll sit within the wider People Capability team, reporting into the Chief People Officer and Chief of Staff, playing a pivotal role in connecting our people strategy to the day-to-day experience of our business.

You'll lead a team of four - a People Business Partner Lead and People Business Partners - spanning the UK and APAC. This is a senior leadership role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, global technology business, brings strong commercial instincts, and knows how to build trusted relationships within the team, and at every level of the organisation.

🚀 What you'll own

  • Lead, develop, and inspire a team of four People BPs globally, fostering a high-performance, collaborative, and commercially-minded team culture.

  • Act as a trusted strategic advisor to senior leaders and executive stakeholders, translating business priorities into people plans that drive performance and engagement.

  • Own the evolving people partnering operating model - setting the standard for how the function delivers across the employee lifecycle; from org design and workforce planning to talent management,employee relations, and offboarding.

  • Partner closely with the Chief People Officer and Chief of Staff to shape and execute Kraken's people strategy, ensuring it reflects the culture, and the needs of a rapidly growing and changing global business.

  • Coach, advise, and collaborate on complex, sensitive, and high-profile ER matters, bringing sound judgement, clear process, and a fair and empathetic approach.

  • Drive organisational effectiveness initiatives including restructures, role design, capability building, and team design, partnering cross-functionally to ensure execution is smooth and thoughtful.

  • Champion data-led people practices - using workforce insights and people analytics to inform decisions and demonstrate impact.

  • Represent the People BP function in leadership forums, contributing to the broader People Capability agenda and influencing how we attract, develop, and retain talent globally.

  • Support Kraken's international growth by providing people partnering expertise as we enter new markets and scale existing ones.

  • Build strong relationships with COE partners (Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, L&D, and People Operations) to ensure a consistent people experience developed with our culture in mind.

🧠 What you bring to the party

  • Significant experience in senior People Business Partnering or HR leadership roles (10 years), ideally within a fast-growing technology or global organisation.

  • Proven track record of leading and developing a team of People BPs, with the ability to coach, delegate, and agree clear direction.

  • A credible and confident communicator with demonstrated experience influencing C-suite and senior business stakeholders.

  • Deep understanding of the full people partner toolkit - org design, workforce planning, talent management, succession, and complex ER.

  • Data-literate with the ability to use people insights to shape strategy and tell compelling stories to stakeholders.

  • Strong commercial acumen; you understand how people decisions drive business outcomes and can connect the dots between the two.

  • Experience operating across multiple geographies and time zones, with an understanding of employment frameworks in the UK, Europe, and ideally APAC.

  • Ability to operate with pace and pragmatism in an ambiguous, high-growth environment while maintaining rigour and quality in delivery.

  • Collaborative by nature - you build bridges across teams and bring people with you, rather than working in silos.

  • Experience in the energy, utilities, or climate tech sector.

jobs.title: Global Head of Strategic Deals
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in

You'll own the commercial negotiation of our largest customer deals end to end. That covers tier-1 SaaS, managed services, and core billing platform deals with regulated utilities and energy retailers. You'll report to the Chief Commercial Officer and carry board-level accountability for deals above $100m.

You'll lead a cross-functional deal team and make sure every seat is filled by the right person:

  • Executive sponsor and deal owner: holds the mandate on our side, approves the commercial envelope, and breaks deadlocks fast.

  • Lead negotiator: runs the table, controls pacing and concessions, and stays separate from the delivery owner. This is the seat you'll usually hold.

  • Pricing and deal economics lead: builds the deal model and covers pricing structures, margin, cash flow, and cost to serve.

  • Legal and contracts counsel: covers liability caps, intellectual property (IP) ownership, indemnities, termination, data protection, and the exit terms we can accept.

  • Solution architect and delivery lead: tests feasibility, scope, service levels (SLAs), and migration plans, and signs off what we can commit to.

  • Sales and account lead: owns the customer relationship, the pursuit plan, and executive sponsorship on the customer side.

  • Finance: covers payment terms, currency and indexation, revenue recognition, and approval thresholds.

  • Risk, security, and compliance: handles regulatory, data residency, and resilience requirements.

🚀 What you'll own

  • Lead negotiation of multi-year SaaS, core billing, and managed services agreements worth $250m to $1bn+ in total contract value, from proposal through signature.

  • Set the commercial playbook: pricing architecture, walk-away positions, a concession log, and fallback positions on liability, service levels, and exit.

  • Agree one position before you sit down. Rank priorities as must-have, trade, or give, and define your walk-away point (your best alternative to a negotiated agreement, or BATNA).

  • Structure deals that fit the risk and protect our margin: per-account bands, volume tiers, indexation, and price-down glide paths, with clear limits on how far we'll go.

  • Decide which risks to accept, share, or refuse, and put a price on each one.

  • Negotiate core billing and Customer Information System (CIS) replacements, including migration plans, regulatory change, service levels, and exit terms.

  • Define scope precisely: baseline, assumptions, dependencies, and exclusions. Most disputes start here, so you'll settle them before signature.

  • Set tiered deal-approval thresholds and discount discipline, so concessions on price and liability stay inside policy.

  • Shape pursuits with Sales, from capture planning to executive briefings, and build the case to win against incumbent billing vendors.

  • Handle the customer's leverage tactics, such as a competing bid, a procurement deadline, or a "sign now" ask, without giving away margin.

  • Bring Delivery and Product into the deal early, so scope, migration plans, and roadmap commitments are signed off before contract.

  • Protect margin after signature: keep change-order discipline and scope control, and track renewals and expansion alongside the headline price.

  • Recruit and grow the team: deal desk and pursuit leads, pricing finance, deal legal, and energy-billing specialists, with a clear capability model and a RACI (who's responsible, accountable, consulted, and informed).

  • Coach executive sponsors and sales leaders on leverage and timing, and run negotiation war-gaming before the big moments.

  • Step in early when a deal or migration drifts, and reset milestones, scope, and commercials with the customer to get it back on track.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

Experience

  • Ideally 20+ years winning and negotiating multi-year enterprise software, SaaS, or platform deals, ideally with regulated utilities or energy retailers.

  • A track record on 15+ transactions of $250m to $1bn+ total contract value, including core billing or CIS platforms, at target margin.

  • Experience leading a deal desk, pursuit, or commercial negotiation team, with accountability for bookings, margin, and contract risk.

  • Energy domain knowledge: meter-to-cash, tariffs, market codes, and regulatory billing obligations.

  • The credibility to work with boards, CFOs, and regulators, and to say no when a deal doesn't add up.

Capabilities

  • Commercial acumen. You understand deal economics and margin levers, and you know where deals make and lose money (discounting, liability concessions, and change requests, for example).

  • Deal structuring. You choose the right pricing model, and you set volume bands, indexation, and price-down paths that hold up over 5 to 10 years.

  • Risk allocation judgment. You know which risks we can accept, share, or refuse, and you can price them.

  • Competitive strategy. You build leverage through capture planning, proof points, and references, and you know how to displace an incumbent.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Customer

 

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

Who are we looking for?

We’re looking for a brilliant senior Data & Analytics Client Delivery Lead to help clients fully leverage Kraken data and transform their data team and capabilities. You should bring extensive experience doing analytics on a strong, modern data team (e.g., data analytics, business intelligence, or related field -- analytics manager, lead data analyst, analytics or data consultant or similar); a love of working with clients; and a passion for driving the clean energy transition – energy sector experience is a plus!

 

The role

You’ll work directly with Kraken clients to help them develop modern, transformative data and analytics capabilities as part of their broader Kraken transformation. You’ll train them on Kraken data and support them in building critical reporting & insightful analytics, sometimes getting hands-on with query writing or demo analytics. 

 

You’ll also leverage your experience leading strong analytics teams to advise senior client data leadership on how to build a high-performing, business-centric data organization and leverage data as a strategic asset to unlock ambitious business and clean energy goals.

 

We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for a hands-on Data & Analytics Client Delivery Lead that can support both directly and indirectly - sometimes jumping in and writing queries or solving data challenges and other times advising or upskilling both clients and colleagues. 

 

You will play a critical role in ensuring the clients’ reporting and analytics transition to Kraken goes smoothly - and ensuring that clients build the transformative data capabilities needed to get full value from Kraken data and power aspirational business goals.

What you’ll do:

  • Guide clients in redefining critical reporting and analytics to use new Kraken data and concepts, through hands-on query writing, working sessions, and trainings

  • Advise clients, including senior leadership, on topics like how to develop a high-performing data organization, how to build a modern tech stack, and how to pursue a data strategy and priorities that drive their core business objectives.

  • Strategically define and prioritize client data needs to influence the data product roadmap, ensuring product understands the core, shared client needs and that solutions achieve clients’ desired business outcomes

  • Partner with engineering to deliver new data features and requirements aligned to client use cases

  • Train Kraken’s broader client delivery team on how to help their respective business domains ask effective data questions and leverage data directly to drive business impact

What you’ll need to have / be:

  • Degree qualified equivalent, with strong client delivery and/or product ownership experience

  • Several years of experience as a data analytics, business intelligence, or related field -- analytics manager, lead data analyst, analytics or data consultant or similar

  • Strong familiarity with modern data practices and tools

  • Familiarity with SQL

  • Familiar with agile product development practices and experience collaborating with engineering

  • Excellent communications, collaboration and presentation skills

  • Strong influencing skills and ability to challenge traditional ways of thinking

  • Patience – our clients are undergoing huge transformations that take time and require our understanding

  • Experience in the energy sector a plus

  • Native Level Japanese and Business Level English

Kraken is a certified Great Place to Work in France, Germany, Spain, Japan, Australia, and USA. In the UK we are one of the Best Workplaces on Glassdoor with a score of 4.5. Check out our Welcome to the Jungle site (FR/EN) to learn more about our teams and culture.

 

Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at inclusion@kraken.tech. We’ll do our best to tailor the experience to your needs so you can feel comfortable, confident and be at your best!

Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. We consider all applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

These policies explain how we handle your data and outline your rights under applicable laws, including, but not limited to, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills.

 

You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. 

 

While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio.

 

When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt.

Key Responsibilities: what you'll do

  • Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement:

  • Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme.

  • Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation.

  • Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions.

  • Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation.

  • Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations.

 

Project Management:

  • Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised.

  • Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track.

  • Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs.

 

Mentorship & Coaching:

  • Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation.

  • Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies.

 

Analytical & Problem-Solving:

  • Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct.

  • Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes.

  • Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence:

  • Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and  Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations.

  • Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration.

  • Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality.

 

Driving Organisational Change:

  • Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach.

  • Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success.

Skills: what you'll have

  • Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions.

  • Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies.

  • Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions.

  • Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience.

 

Experience

  • Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level.

  • Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively.

  • Change management using agile methodologies.

  • Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. 

 

Other Requirements:

  • Ability to travel globally, with placement based on preference when possible, but flexibility required according to client needs.

  • Ability to work across multiple clients and markets, quickly adapting to varying client needs and environments/languages.

  • Highly driven to ‘make things happen’. Growth mindset demonstrated through all your work. Ability to speak persuasively and inspire energy, motivating both internal teams and external stakeholders including Direct Reports.

  • Comfortable navigating between operations and technical conversations, bridging gaps between business needs and technical solutions.

  • Expertise in driving programme ownership, from inception through to sustainable execution, ensuring clients are equipped to lead post-migration.

  • Fluent German & Dutch is a prerequisite for this role

Please submit your resume in English 🇬🇧

This position involves travelling across different European countries 🚃

You may see this role listed as "Client Enablement and Coaching Lead". This is to help the right people find it. The actual job title is Client Delivery Lead.

jobs.descriptionPlain:

Kraken https://kraken.tech/ powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.



What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills.

 

You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. 

 

While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio.

 

When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt.

Key Responsibilities: what you'll do

 - Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement:

 - Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme.

 - Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation.

 - Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions.

 - Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation.

 - Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations.

 

Project Management:

 - Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised.

 - Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track.

 - Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs.

 

Mentorship & Coaching:

 - Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation.

 - Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies.

 

Analytical & Problem-Solving:

 - Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct.

 - Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes.

 - Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence:

 - Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and  Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations.

 - Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration.

 - Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality.

 

Driving Organisational Change:

 - Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach.

 - Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success.
   
   

Skills: what you'll have

 - Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines.

 - Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions.

 - Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies.

 - Deep technical understanding of Kraken's products and services, including migration processes and temporary solutions.

 - Demonstrating leadership practices and promoting professionalism in client interactions Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex concepts and principles to a varied audience.

 

Experience

 - Proven communication at all levels, able to leverage style at Exec level.

 - Exposure to outsourcing models (BPOs), understanding their drivers, challenges, and how to manage these relationships effectively.

 - Change management using agile methodologies.

 - Proven record of creating high performing teams, either internally within operations or externally with clients. 

 

Other Requirements:

 - Ability to travel globally, with placement based on preference when possible, but flexibility required according to client needs.

 - Ability to work across multiple clients and markets, quickly adapting to varying client needs and environments/languages.

 - Highly driven to ‘make things happen’. Growth mindset demonstrated through all your work. Ability to speak persuasively and inspire energy, motivating both internal teams and external stakeholders including Direct Reports.

 - Comfortable navigating between operations and technical conversations, bridging gaps between business needs and technical solutions.

 - Expertise in driving programme ownership, from inception through to sustainable execution, ensuring clients are equipped to lead post-migration.

 - Fluent German & Dutch is a prerequisite for this role

jobs.title: Delivery Manager - Generation Flex
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Generation Flex
The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves to be at the heart of that change.

Our aim is to be the leading global provider of solutions that enable customers to release £30bn of value per annum from distributed energy resources (DERs). We are building a Software as a Service (SaaS) subscription business with a global addressable market of £2.4 billion per annum, by digitally connecting hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets.

We have already attained a market leading position and Kraken is a recognised thought leader and innovator in the industry.

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU with a focus on Germany.

This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform.

You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated.

Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding:

Customer: What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them?

Product: How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required?

Engineering: How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work?

Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

  • Build a strong understanding of the Generation Flex product and SaaS platform, including how assets are represented, configured, monitored and controlled within KrakenFlex.

  • Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding.

  • Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset.

  • Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements, making sure each group understands what is needed from the others.

  • Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required.

  • Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules.

  • Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective.

  • Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early.

  • Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition.

  • Be the primary delivery point of contact for customers during site onboarding, setting clear expectations around what we need from them, what Kraken is delivering and what needs to happen next.

  • Work closely with our Electrical Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams to ensure the technical information required to integrate a site is complete, accurate and available at the right stage of delivery.

  • Review and interpret customer technical documentation including:

    • Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)

    • Network and communications diagrams

    • Site and asset specifications

    • PPC and controller documentation

    • Modbus register maps

    • IP addressing and network information

    • Functional Design Specifications

    • Metering and telemetry information

    • Hardware and connectivity requirements

  • Be confident discussing technical site architecture with customers and engineers, understanding how equipment such as generators, batteries, meters, PPCs, controllers, gateways and site networks fit together.

  • Identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear customer information early and drive it to resolution before it becomes a delivery blocker.

  • Coordinate the preparation and review of Kraken integration documentation, including gateway architecture, communications diagrams, Kraken SLDs, integration designs and site configuration information.

  • Coordinate the Kraken Gateway delivery and installation process, ensuring prerequisites such as power, networking, connectivity and installation arrangements are understood and ready.

  • Manage readiness for key commissioning and testing activities, including:

    • Gateway installation and connectivity

    • Operational acceptance testing

    • Kraken market and service testing

  • Proactively manage delivery risks and communicate issues and mitigation plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Surface blockers early and drive the right people together to resolve them rather than allowing issues to sit between teams.

  • Maintain clear visibility of the status and health of each site, including technical readiness, product readiness, customer actions, Kraken actions and upcoming milestones.

  • Continuously improve the Generation Flex onboarding process, identifying recurring technical, product or customer blockers and working with Engineering, Product and Operations teams to remove them.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • A strong technical background and the confidence to work closely with electrical, control systems, and networking.

  • A practical understanding of industrial networking and communications, including concepts such as IP addressing, LANs, routers, switches, VPNs and site connectivity.

  • Enough electrical engineering knowledge to understand concepts such as metering, breakers, transformers, generators, inverters, batteries and asset control systems.

  • Experience delivering technical projects involving the integration, commissioning or onboarding of physical assets, ideally within energy, renewables, utilities, industrial automation, controls or a similar environment.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to take a complicated technical problem and clearly explain the issue, impact, owner and next action.

  • Experience coordinating multiple teams and dependencies across customers, Electrical Engineering, hardware, installation partners and other third parties.

  • A highly organised approach to delivery, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple sites at different stages of onboarding simultaneously.

  • The ability to proactively identify risk, remove blockers and maintain momentum in an environment where customer readiness and site timelines can change quickly.

  • A customer-centric mindset and a drive to provide an outstanding onboarding experience without compromising technical quality.

  • A pragmatic, collaborative approach and the confidence to operate in a fast-moving environment where processes and products are still evolving.

  • A strong interest in understanding how a SaaS product works end-to-end, rather than treating the software platform as a black box.

  • A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment, comfortable navigating the complexity and comfortable being the regional face of site onboarding function.

  • Language: professional fluency in German and English

⭐ Bonus points

  • Experience in APIs, data flows, system integrations or cloud software architecture would be beneficial.

  • Experience in flexible generation, battery storage, renewable energy, demand response or distributed energy resources.

  • A working understanding of industrial communication protocols and controlled environments would be helpful (e.g. modbus, OPC UA

  • Experience commissioning or integrating generators, BESS, solar, EV infrastructure or other industrial energy assets.

  • Previous experience working with grid-connected assets, control systems or energy market services.

  • Experience with SaaS implementation, technical product onboarding or systems integration.

  • Familiarity with commissioning processes and the distinction between cold commissioning, energisation and hot commissioning.

  • Experience with industrial gateways, edge devices or IoT connectivity.

Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at inclusion@kraken.tech. We’ll do our best to tailor the experience to your needs so you can feel comfortable, confident and be at your best!

Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we’re looking for! At Kraken, we're creating a team of genuine, honest, empathetic people. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. We consider all applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

*Our (i) Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice and Artificial Intelligence (AI) Notice, (ii) Website Privacy Notice and (iii) Cookie Notice govern the collection and use of your personal data in connection with your application and use of our website. These policies explain how we handle your data and outline your rights under applicable laws, including, but not limited to, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your information, object to processing, or withdraw consent. By applying, you acknowledge that you’ve read, understood and consent to these terms

Please note that, in line with our current recruitment policy, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position; applicants must have the right to work in the country that they're applying to, at the time of application.*

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer II (Integrations)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🐙 Kraken Generation Flex

The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In the UK, with a legally binding Net Zero target for 2050 and a clean-power ambition for 2030, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid.

Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. With complete independence from Octopus Energy, we are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As our UK fleet grows and we support our expansion across Europe, we are looking for an Integrations Engineer to help turn customer sites into market-connected, controllable assets.

🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary

As we scale our fleet of integrated assets, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to support the delivery of our site integrations and grow into owning them, learning the full lifecycle from the early information stage through design, deployment and testing.

You’ll be part of an engineering delivery team, based in Manchester, who take an integration project from the very early information stage, design how it will be integrated into Kraken’s platform and then turn that design into a live, controllable, market-participating asset.

Engineering delivery is an innovative and engineering-focused team with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system. Alongside design, deployment and testing; they constantly look into ways to improve efficiency through tooling and the automation of repetitive tasks. They collaborate daily with delivery managers and customer success to onboard new sites as well as support the existing.

🚀 What you'll own

  • Integration design contribution: With guidance, analyse provided information and contribute to hardware and software integration approaches. When necessary, exchange information with customer technical representatives through meetings and emails, and take part in design discussions with other team members.

  • Technical judgement: Develop your technical judgement, making well-reasoned decisions and trade-offs with support from senior engineers, and contributing technical input to discussions within the team.

  • Developing domain knowledge: Build up your knowledge in one or more technical areas. This could include grid regulations (G99, G100, Grid Code etc.), energy markets, multi BMUs, industrial communication protocols, industrial networking, internet of things, cyber security and so on.

  • Gateway application & configuration: Learn how the Gateway software (developed by an internal software team) works and how it is configured. Understand the requirements for an integration and judge if the gateway software is able to support it or will need new development work. The team will help you get gateway configuration literate and you will carry out deployments and changes independently over time.

  • Hardware and Software Deployments: Learn the process of our hardware and software deployments. Over time, take ownership of the configuration, deployment and testing with guidance from the senior engineers.

  • Networking and cyber security: Contribute to hardware and network connectivity designs, keeping our own cyber security posture in mind as well as addressing the concerns from customers, with the support of the internal security team.

  • Site testing & commissioning: Carry out site testing and commissioning initially with the support of the team and building toward doing this independently as onboarding demand grows.

  • Incidents & compliance: Help address engineering help requests from other teams and support incident response in the case of issues at existing sites.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

  • Understanding of the Regulations: Working knowledge of the UK Grid Code, G99 and the other obligations of a grid-connected asset before it can participate in the energy markets.

  • Understanding of the UK Energy Markets: Working understanding of the NESO ancillary services (Dynamic Containment / Moderation / Regulation, Firm Frequency Response), the Balancing Mechanism, and the DNO connection/integration process.

  • Technical judgement: Sound technical judgement and a structured approach to problems, working with the team to agree and implement a solution.

  • Power plant systems: Ability to read and analyse single line diagrams for a given power plant to understand the site architecture for the points of metering and control instrumentation.

  • Asset integration: Exposure to, or a keen interest in, integrating BESS (grid-scale and/or C&I) and/or RES (Wind and Solar) for telemetry and control.

  • Integration design: Ability to contribute to clear integration designs and design documentation.

  • Hardware and Networking: Familiarity with control systems deployments and their connectivity including the local networking and cyber security aspects, and an ability to help debug site connectivity and networking issues (including 4G routers and firewalls) with support.

  • Industrial Communication Protocols: Practical experience or a good working knowledge of Modbus (TCP/RTU); awareness of one or more of IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25, OPC-UA or DNP3 is a plus.

  • CAD, Diagrams and Tools: Experience or familiarity with CAD tools such as AutoCAD or BricsCAD, Miro and Notion.

  • Communication: A clear communicator who documents their work (e.g. in design docs and Notion) and collaborates well with the team.

  • Commissioning landscape: Awareness of the other parties involved in site commissioning for power plants, their roles and responsibilities, and how we work with them.

  • Engineering background: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, Software, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration.

  • A proactive and collaborative mindset: You are eager to learn and grow, reliable and collaborative. You take initiative, communicate openly, raise risks early, and care about safe working. You welcome feedback, support your teammates, and steadily build toward taking on more independent ownership of integrations over time.

  • Travel: Willingness to travel to customers and sites although travel is very occasional. Awareness of site safety is required as we may work with site personnel even though we are remote.

⭐️ Bonus points

  • Wider knowledge of grid compliance (G99, G100, Grid Code) and where the Kraken system fits in.

  • Experience with AWS IoT Greengrass or similar edge-deployment architectures.

  • Familiarity with software/scripting and templating (e.g. Python, Rust, the Linux command line) and Git-based workflows.

  • Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector (IEC 62443, NIS Regulations awareness).

  • Exposure to wider European balancing markets / ENTSO-E frameworks and TSO integrations.

If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at inclusion@kraken.tech. We’ll do our best to tailor the experience to your needs so you can feel comfortable, confident and be at your best!

🏠 WHERE YOU’LL FIT IN AND ROLE SUMMARY

As we scale our fleet of integrated assets, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to support the delivery of our site integrations and grow into owning them, learning the full lifecycle from the early information stage through design, deployment and testing.

You’ll be part of an engineering delivery team, based in Manchester, who take an integration project from the very early information stage, design how it will be integrated into Kraken’s platform and then turn that design into a live, controllable, market-participating asset.

Engineering delivery is an innovative and engineering-focused team with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system. Alongside design, deployment and testing; they constantly look into ways to improve efficiency through tooling and the automation of repetitive tasks. They collaborate daily with delivery managers and customer success to onboard new sites as well as support the existing.




🚀 WHAT YOU'LL OWN

When necessary, exchange information with customer technical representatives through meetings and emails, and take part in design discussions with other team members.

 - Technical judgement: Develop your technical judgement, making well-reasoned decisions and trade-offs with support from senior engineers, and contributing technical input to discussions within the team.

 - Developing domain knowledge: Build up your knowledge in one or more technical areas. This could include grid regulations (G99, G100, Grid Code etc.), energy markets, multi BMUs, industrial communication protocols, industrial networking, internet of things, cyber security and so on.

 - Gateway application & configuration: Learn how the Gateway software (developed by an internal software team) works and how it is configured. Understand the requirements for an integration and judge if the gateway software is able to support it or will need new development work. The team will help you get gateway configuration literate and you will carry out deployments and changes independently over time.

 - Hardware and Software Deployments: Learn the process of our hardware and software deployments. Over time, take ownership of the configuration, deployment and testing with guidance from the senior engineers.

 - Networking and cyber security: Contribute to hardware and network connectivity designs, keeping our own cyber security posture in mind as well as addressing the concerns from customers, with the support of the internal security team.

 - Site testing & commissioning: Carry out site testing and commissioning initially with the support of the team and building toward doing this independently as onboarding demand grows.

 - Incidents & compliance: Help address engineering help requests from other teams and support incident response in the case of issues at existing sites.




🧠 WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE PARTY

 - Understanding of the UK Energy Markets: Working understanding of the NESO ancillary services (Dynamic Containment / Moderation / Regulation, Firm Frequency Response), the Balancing Mechanism, and the DNO connection/integration process.

 - Technical judgement: Sound technical judgement and a structured approach to problems, working with the team to agree and implement a solution.

 - Power plant systems: Ability to read and analyse single line diagrams for a given power plant to understand the site architecture for the points of metering and control instrumentation.

 - Asset integration: Exposure to, or a keen interest in, integrating BESS (grid-scale and/or C&I) and/or RES (Wind and Solar) for telemetry and control.

 - Integration design: Ability to contribute to clear integration designs and design documentation.

 - Hardware and Networking: Familiarity with control systems deployments and their connectivity including the local networking and cyber security aspects, and an ability to help debug site connectivity and networking issues (including 4G routers and firewalls) with support.

 - Industrial Communication Protocols: Practical experience or a good working knowledge of Modbus (TCP/RTU); awareness of one or more of IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25, OPC-UA or DNP3 is a plus.

 - CAD, Diagrams and Tools: Experience or familiarity with CAD tools such as AutoCAD or BricsCAD, Miro and Notion.

 - Communication: A clear communicator who documents their work (e.g. in design docs and Notion) and collaborates well with the team.

 - Commissioning landscape: Awareness of the other parties involved in site commissioning for power plants, their roles and responsibilities, and how we work with them.

 - Engineering background: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, Software, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration.

 - A proactive and collaborative mindset: You are eager to learn and grow, reliable and collaborative. You take initiative, communicate openly, raise risks early, and care about safe working. You welcome feedback, support your teammates, and steadily build toward taking on more independent ownership of integrations over time.

 - Travel: Willingness to travel to customers and sites although travel is very occasional. Awareness of site safety is required as we may work with site personnel even though we are remote.


⭐️ BONUS POINTS

 - Wider knowledge of grid compliance (G99, G100, Grid Code) and where the Kraken system fits in.

 - Experience with AWS IoT Greengrass or similar edge-deployment architectures.

 - Familiarity with software/scripting and templating (e.g. Python, Rust, the Linux command line) and Git-based workflows.

 - Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector (IEC 62443, NIS Regulations awareness).

 - Exposure to wider European balancing markets / ENTSO-E frameworks and TSO integrations.
