The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In Germany, home to the largest electricity market in Europe and a roadmap toward Net Zero by 2045, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid.

Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. We are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As we expand our footprint in Germany and the wider European market, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to lead our regional technical market-access and integration efforts.

🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and customer growth in Germany, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to work with stakeholders to develop our DSR (Demand Side Response) and flexibility pipeline.

You will be bringing your regional technical expertise to aid the development of our asset integration technologies. The role is highly cross-functional: you'll bridge our software and hardware capabilities with the rigorous requirements of the four German Transmission System Operators (TSOs) and 900+ Distribution System Operators (DSOs).

The detailed Gateway (Kraken’s IoT Edge Hardware&Software) configuration and protocol engineering is owned by our UK-based team, whom you will feed with regional knowledge and design input, and who will support you on the technical aspects of how Kraken integrations work. You will own the regional relationship, the integration approach, and the design that the UK team then implements. The role may require you to attend customer calls, as well as calls with the TSO and DSOs to technically explain/defend our strategy.

You will join a team, based in Manchester, that is innovative and engineering-focused, with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system.

🚀 What you'll own

  • Market Access & Prequalification: Drive the technical approach for connecting assets — mainly BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar) into German ancillary-service markets (FCR, aFRR, mFRR) and Redispatch 3.0. Support prequalification (Präqualifikation) with the relevant TSO and ensure our telemetry and control approach satisfies TSO-specific and BNetzA requirements for market participation. (Grid-code and plant-compliance obligations such as VDE-AR-N 4110/4120 remain with the plant/PPC; your focus is enabling market access, telemetry, and dispatch.)

  • Integration Technology (your core deliverable): Carry out research, engage technical stakeholders and engineers to design our established integration approaches for various asset types such as BESS, Wind, Solar, CHP and more. This can cover both new projects and retrofits.

  • Regional Technical Expertise: Be the regional authority who feeds and supports the UK team with knowledge of German hardware requirements, industrial protocols, connectivity, cyber-security expectations, and TSO/DSO and ancillary-service requirements. Help evaluate hardware and connectivity solutions for regional fit.

  • Stakeholder Liaison: Act as the technical point of contact for TSOs, DSOs, customers, and internal commercial teams to resolve connection, onboarding, or operational issues.

  • Hardware & On-site Support (occasional): Hardware is deployed remotely in most cases via O&Ms and third parties. However, occasional regional support and hands-on intervention may be required before or after a deployment, including some hardware handling and on-site engineering. You’ll ideally be based close to Kraken’s Berlin office and the role requires the ability to travel when needed, though this is kept to a minimum.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

  • Language: Native or professional fluency in German and English, essential for technical documentation and TSO/regulator communication.

  • Engineering background: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration).

  • Integration & connectivity: Proven experience establishing industrial communication and connectivity between field equipment and external systems (telemetry and/or control).

  • Power-plant systems: Working understanding of power-plant control systems and instrumentation, including metering.

  • German market knowledge:

    • TSO/DSO hierarchy and the connection/integration process.

    • Ancillary services (FCR, aFRR, mFRR) prequalification and technical requirements.

    • Redispatch 3.0 regulatory framework.

  • Customer-facing delivery: Ability to produce technical integration approaches and communicate them to customers, regulators, and internal teams.

  • Travel: Occasional travel may be required.

  • A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment, comfortable navigating the complexity of a multi-TSO, decentralised grid, and comfortable being the regional face of a technical function whose deep build sits with a partner team in the UK.

⭐️ Bonus points

  • Knowledge of industrial communication protocols: IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25 (wind), OPC-UA, Modbus, or similar IEC protocols.

  • Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector (NIS2, EnWG/KRITIS awareness; IEC 62443 a plus).

  • Familiarity with CLI tools for configuring, diagnosing, and maintaining hardware or network connections in remote, Linux-based environments.

  • Familiarity with software languages, version-controlled configuration, and general tooling.

  • Exposure to the wider European balancing markets / ENTSO-E frameworks beyond Germany.

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Utilities

 

Our tech platform ‘Kraken’ is already licensed to support 90 million customer accounts globally, and we aim to serve 100 million by 2027. Kraken is the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimising resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications.

 

We’re now charging the Kraken platform to other utility industries (Water and Broadband) and have created a new team called - Kraken Utilities. Over the last 3 years we have built this team from scratch to re-architect, design, and develop our Kraken software platform to solve complex industry wide problems within the water and broadband sectors (such as customer experience & water leak detection).

 

The Kraken Utilities team is in a very exciting growth phase, and has already signed six key clients: Severn Trent, Leep, Portsmouth Water, Essential Energy, TalkTalk, and Cuckoo. We are currently 120+ people strong globally.

What you’ll do:

  • We have lots of difficult design challenges to solve. The UK utilities market is complicated, outdated and process-heavy - there's an awful lot of domain modelling that we need to get right. Strong attention to detail is essential.

  • Help build and scale the Kraken utilities team by embedding an engineering, problem solving, and customer-first culture.

  • Architect & develop new components of the Kraken platform to serve other utilities.

  • We have a lot of challenging problems to solve as we work to improve the utilities industry. You will help find the right technology to build complex lifecycle journeys and payment flows, deal with hard industry problems, and support the processing of millions of readings.

  • There's a great opportunity for disruption in the UK water and broadband markets. The landscape is changing as we move to more dis-aggregated forms of generation, with less predictability, more dynamism and smarter technology.

  • You'll be working for a company that’s fighting climate change. Our generation arm is the largest investor in solar generation in the UK, and is funding wind and anaerobic digestion. As a supplier, we're helping people to use greener technology and renewable energy, all helping move the UK towards a lower carbon future.

What you'll need:

We're looking for someone with a general interest in technology and problem-solving; someone diligent and thoughtful. Experience with the following:

  • Python

  • Django (or equiv. web framework)

  • Domain modelling

  • HTTP and REST APIs

  • Writing robust and fault-tolerant software

  • Celery and async processing

  • Postgres

Plus experience in the following would be a bonus:

  • AWS

  • Terraform, Packer, Consul

  • React and Redux

jobs.title: Senior Delivery Manager - GenFlex
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

 

About the team

Our GenFlex platform helps energy companies connect, control and optimise large-scale flexible energy assets - including battery energy storage systems (BESS), solar, wind and other generation assets.

GenFlex connects physical energy assets with the technology needed to monitor telemetry, control and dispatch assets, optimise their operation and provide reporting back to clients and energy-market participants.

We're looking for a Senior Delivery Manager to join our team in Japan and lead Kraken's delivery and onboarding of grid-scale energy assets, with an initial focus on battery storage projects.

This is not a traditional construction or EPC project-management role. You'll own Kraken's part of the delivery - working across our clients, Engineering, Product and external technical partners to make sure assets are successfully connected to GenFlex and ready for live operation.

 
 

What you'll do

You'll be responsible for driving complex GenFlex implementations in Japan from initial discovery through onboarding, integration, go-live and transition into ongoing operations.

You'll:

  • Lead Kraken's delivery and onboarding of grid-scale battery and other flexible energy assets in Japan.

  • Own the delivery plan for Kraken's scope, making sure responsibilities, dependencies, milestones and deliverables are clear from the beginning.

  • Build strong relationships with Japanese clients and act as a trusted delivery partner throughout implementation.

  • Coordinate across client teams, Kraken Product and Engineering, traders, EPC partners, Procurement and other external stakeholders.

  • Drive the three key areas of GenFlex onboarding: market, customer and site onboarding.

  • Work with technical teams to connect physical assets to Kraken, including the integration and deployment of gateways used for real-time communication with battery sites.

  • Coordinate requirements around telemetry, controls, APIs, data and site connectivity.

  • Work through technical and delivery issues, bringing the right people together to identify root causes and unblock progress.

  • Understand external dependencies such as asset construction, commissioning, grid connection and energisation dates, and manage Kraken's delivery around them.

  • Keep clients and internal teams clearly informed on progress, risks, decisions and changing priorities.

  • Manage competing requirements and have clear, diplomatic conversations when expectations, timelines or technical constraints need to be challenged.

  • Support clients through testing, go-live and the transition into stable operations.

  • Help improve our GenFlex delivery processes, documentation and ways of working as we scale in Japan.

GenFlex implementations can involve many different stakeholders and dependencies. While Kraken doesn't own the client's overall battery construction programme, our Delivery team is responsible for making sure Kraken's technology, integrations and deliverables are ready at the right time.

 
 

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone who combines strong delivery leadership with technical curiosity and excellent client management.

You'll ideally have:

  • Significant experience leading complex technology implementations, integrations or technical delivery programmes.

  • Experience delivering projects within energy, utilities, grid technology, renewable energy, battery storage or another complex infrastructure/technology environment.

  • Strong end-to-end delivery ownership - you're comfortable getting into the detail rather than only managing projects from a high level.

  • Experience working directly with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders.

  • The confidence to challenge requirements, manage expectations and navigate difficult client conversations when needed.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and experience coordinating multiple internal and external teams.

  • Good technical understanding and the confidence to work closely with software, hardware and engineering teams.

  • Experience working with integrations, APIs, data, connected assets or other technically complex systems.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate effectively when requirements or solutions aren't immediately clear.

  • Fluent / business-level Japanese is essential, as you'll work directly with clients and partners in Japan.

  • Strong English communication skills, as you'll work extensively with Kraken's global Product, Engineering and Delivery teams.

     

Particularly useful experience

You don't need experience across everything below, but exposure to some of these areas would be highly valuable:

  • Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)

  • Grid-scale battery projects

  • DERMS / VPP / flexibility platforms

  • Energy Management Systems (EMS)

  • SCADA / telemetry / control systems

  • Renewable energy assets

  • Electricity markets and grid operations

  • Asset optimisation / dispatch

  • Site integration and commissioning

  • Physical/edge gateways

  • APIs and cloud-based platform integrations

GenFlex itself operates across asset connectivity and control, real-time events and monitoring, optimisation and reporting. The platform processes very large volumes of telemetry and connects to large assets such as batteries through cloud integrations or physical gateways.

 
 

What makes this role different

This isn't a standard SaaS implementation.

You'll be working at the intersection of software, physical energy assets, grid infrastructure and client operations.

One conversation might be with a senior client stakeholder about programme milestones and risks; the next could involve Engineering discussing telemetry from a battery site, gateway connectivity or why an asset isn't responding as expected.

You'll need to be comfortable moving between the big picture and the technical detail - understanding what needs to happen, who needs to be involved and how to keep a complex delivery moving forward.

Our onboarding teams bring together Delivery Managers, site analysts, hardware engineers and test engineers, with projects often spanning months because of dependencies across Engineering, EPC teams, traders, Procurement and grid/market operators.

If you enjoy solving complicated problems, working closely with clients and using technology to help build a smarter, more flexible energy system, we'd love to hear from you. ⚡🔋

 

Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at inclusion@kraken.tech. We’ll do our best to tailor the experience to your needs so you can feel comfortable, confident and be at your best!

Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we’re looking for! At Kraken, we're creating a team of genuine, honest, empathetic people. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. We consider all applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

*Our (i) Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice and Artificial Intelligence (AI) Notice, (ii) Website Privacy Notice and (iii) Cookie Notice govern the collection and use of your personal data in connection with your application and use of our website. These policies explain how we handle your data and outline your rights under applicable laws, including, but not limited to, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your information, object to processing, or withdraw consent. Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Customer

 

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. 

 

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

 

You will be joining the client delivery team with Kraken working to support European clients through their technology transformation journeys, supporting long term migration projects.

The Client Delivery Lead has direct responsibility managing a tech domain (billing, finance, comms..) for our client projects. This is either migrating onto our Kraken platform or managing long term technology requirements. They need to work in partnership with the technology and operational teams at Kraken as well as the client to deliver results for our client’s project or business needs. 

 

The Client Delivery Lead has to really understand how Kraken works, understand problems or requests raised by the client and refine solutions in the best way to leverage existing and new capability. They will bring technology, people and processes together to innovate improvements for our clients. You will also support the client in adapting to ways of working that are aligned to Kraken’s development style. You will work closely with Kraken’s product managers and developers to request development needs and act as a link to the client.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • You will be managing the relationship with client counterparts (often product owners and business owners)

  • You will be the first point of contact for tech development and the escalation and resolution point with customers for specific domain/product issues

  • Being the knowledge base of how Kraken works and how we deliver Kraken Platform

  • Triaging incoming requests and communicating client priorities internally. 

  • Summarising and articulating client needs, considerations, timelines internally to enable the ongoing development of the Kraken platform.

  • Supporting the engineering team to deliver product features

  • Challenging the client to think differently about tech development, having full belief in the continuous iteration and deployment approach we have.

 

This is a hands-on, individual contributor position. The role is European based and your projects could be run from any country, travel is expected as part of this role.

 

We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever changing environment. To thrive here you must be a self-starter and willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem, constantly flexing outside of your typical job role to drive progress for our clients and organisation.

You must be  committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing stakeholders through a journey of change. 

 

You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client. 

 

We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • In this position you will be laser focused on satisfying our customer’s needs. We are looking for people with strong problem solving skills and a super positive solutions oriented mindset. If you have a taste for raising up to challenges and a winner mindset, this position is the right fit for you! (“Every problem has a solution, facing new challenges is exciting because that’s what makes us better every day and the bigger the challenge, the bigger the feeling of success”)

  • Strong client delivery and/or product ownership experience

  • Agile delivery experience 

  • Experience of product management and customer journeys

  • Solid understanding of technology and associated trends

  • Excellent communications, collaboration and presentation skills

  • Strong influencing skills and ability to challenge traditional ways of thinking

  • Experience of working with significant complex delivery pipelines for clients

  • Patience and initiative - our clients are undergoing huge transformations that take time and require our understanding 

  • Time management and a get-stuff-done attitude

  • Consulting experience is a plus 

  • Fluent English + German

  • Previous experience in payments is nice to have for this position

✨ As our Client Delivery Lead, you’ll be driving success and leading projects directly as a key individual contributor, without direct line management responsibilities.

If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We’re a technology company focused on creating a smart, sustainable energy system. From optimising renewable generation, creating a more intelligent grid and enabling utilities to provide excellent customer experiences, our operating system for energy is transforming the industry around the world in a way that benefits everyone.

It’s a really exciting time in energy. Help us make a real impact on shaping a better, more sustainable future.

 

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

We have been licensing Kraken since 2021, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like.

This role will lead the technical orchestration of a major client program, partnering with an international energy retailer in their operational transformation. You will oversee the migration’s technical pillar and manager the ongoing technical relationship, supporting the client’s adoption of our Kraken platform as part of their broader business transformation.

We work incredibly dynamically, and this role is one that will take different shapes throughout the week. We are looking for well rounded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity, are self-starters and willing to roll their sleeves up to get to the nitty gritty of a problem. You must be committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing senior stakeholders through a journey of change.

You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client.

We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • Building trusted relationships with client executives and technology stakeholders, including partnering with our product and engineering teams to align on priorities. Serving as the escalation point for client concerns and ensuring both technical challenges and product requirements are effectively managed

  • Defining success criteria and governance for delivering the technical pillar of the program.

  • Owning the Kraken platform localisation plan to meet client expectations while matching Kraken roadmap

  • Summarising and articulating client needs, considerations, timelines, etc internally as structured input for the successful and timely execution of any required technology platform localisation and development.

  • Directing internal Kraken software developers contributing to the client program, as well as potential external Partners, on tech platform deliverables to ensure an overall successful and timely technology migration.

  • Supporting the client meets their business needs via the delivery of tech.

  • Understanding the Kraken infrastructure, aligning client direction with the overall goal for the Kraken platform & business.

  • Setting up training programs to upskill the technical arm of the client.

  • Being an advocate for the Kraken way of delivering tech and supporting the client in shifting their mindset around tech delivery.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • Communication: You need to be confident in calling out approaches that aren't best for the client and always striving for simplicity. You need to be able to communicate the context behind decisions relating to the platform & client priorities. You must be able to build strong relationships and credibility amongst senior stakeholders, balancing the needs of the client with Kraken’s business needs and platform potential and constraints.

  • Program management: Confident in managing a long term, fast paced program. Can be both high level and dive into detail when required. Ability to directly manage a team and manage processes that can drive the right outcomes for clients.

  • Strong technical aptitude: We are looking for a logical thinker who has strong problem solving skills within an agile working framework. Must quickly be able to grasp the technical capabilities and constraints of the Kraken platform. Is an advocate for the continuous deployment approach we take at Kraken and champions building tech iteratively.

  • Business acumen: Able to understand business goals of both client and Kraken, putting all technology decisions into context to ensure measurable success can be achieved and celebrated.

Experience / Qualifications needed:

  • Technical mindset, experience in engineering-led industries

  • Sector-relevant experience in managing complex technology implementation or migration programs

  • Proven experience in software adaptation, deployment and integration

  • Exceptional interpersonal skills

  • We're looking for prior experience working on CIS implementations within the utilities industry (telco, water, energy etc).

  • This role will require hybrid 3 days a week in our NYC office (Tribeca), with frequent client travel across North America (every 3-4 weeks).

Why you'll love it here:

  • Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options including FSAs.

  • Paid time off — we know working hard means also being able to recharge as needed, we trust our employees to get the work done and take the time they need.

  • 401(k) plan with employer match.

  • Parental leave. Biological, adoptive and foster parents are all eligible.

  • Pre-tax commuter benefits.

  • Flexible working environment: you need to shift around your schedule? You do you, we genuinely believe in work/life balance.

  • Equity Options: every Kraken employee owns part of the business. We’re a team, working together towards huge goals. Every person is crucial to our success, you should be rewarded as such.

  • Modern office or co-working spaces depending on location.

  • The salary range for this role in NYC ranges on average from $180,000-$220,000 depending on relevant experience, role alignment, and technical/client management expertise demonstrated throughout the interview process. jobs.title: Solution Consultant
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

 

About the role

Kraken Solution Consultants help energy companies understand what is possible when brilliant technology, deep industry knowledge and a better operating model come together.

This role sits at the heart of our growth across Asia-Pacific and leads on opportunities spanning both Kraken Distribution and Kraken Customer. Kraken Distribution is the platform for electricity distribution businesses and network operators, covering meter data management, connection point authority (including distributed energy resources), and network billing. Kraken Customer is our market-leading platform for energy retailers, spanning CIS, billing, metering, MDM, CRM and customer communications. You’ll move fluently between these two worlds, shaping engagements that often bring them together.

You’ll bring strong energy-industry experience, curiosity about technology, and the ability to connect client needs to practical Kraken solutions. You’ll be confident discussing network operations, customer operations, system landscapes and how platforms fit together — without losing sight of the people and processes behind them.

This role is ideal for a creative problem solver: someone who listens, asks sharp questions, simplifies complexity and helps clients see how Kraken can support real business change. Because APAC is a diverse, fast-moving region, you’ll be comfortable working across markets, time zones and regulatory contexts.

This isn’t a surface-level role. You’ll get deep into the functional capabilities of the platform — configuring, testing and pressure-testing scenarios yourself — until you hold an intimate, working understanding of how Kraken actually solves a client’s problem, not just how it demos.

 

About the team

We are a global team, organised regionally so we can focus deeply on each market while supporting each other across borders. In APAC that means working closely with colleagues across Australia, New Zealand, Japan and the wider region.

We bring different backgrounds, strengths and perspectives, and work best when people bring their personality, judgement, experience and energy — and get stuck in.

 
 

What you’ll do

  • Lead solution consulting on APAC opportunities across Kraken Distribution and Kraken Customer, working with Sales leadership to qualify opportunities and establish the Kraken engagement strategy.

  • Build trust with prospective and existing clients — including distribution businesses, network operators and energy retailers — helping them understand Kraken and what it could mean for their business.

  • Lead discovery sessions and workshops to understand client operations, pain points, requirements, risks and goals across both network and customer domains.

  • Deliver product demos and workshops that show how Kraken solves real challenges in the energy market, from distribution network services and meter data to retail customer operations.

  • Get hands-on with the product to build genuine functional depth — working through the platform yourself, exploring edge cases and configurations, so you can speak to real capability with authority rather than at a high level.

  • Explain complex concepts simply, tailoring your message for executives, architects, analysts, product owners, operations teams and subject matter experts.

  • Respond to functional and technical questions, bringing in product and engineering colleagues where needed.

  • Own RFPs, proposals, presentations and other sales collateral, especially around functional, solution and technical content.

  • Partner with sales, marketing, product, engineering and delivery teams to share client insight and influence product direction.

  • Stay close to Kraken’s roadmap and product strategy across both Distribution and Customer so you can represent the platform confidently and accurately.

 

What you’ll need

  • Experience working with distribution companies or network operators in a delivery or implementation capacity — you understand how distribution businesses operate and what it takes to deliver technology change for them.

  • Strong understanding of energy industry systems, ideally across both the network/distribution domain (e.g. meter data management, connection point / market data, network field services, distributed energy resources) and the retail/customer domain (CIS, billing, metering, MDM, CRM, customer communications).

  • Genuine curiosity and the ability to ask sharp questions that unpack how clients work today, where the pain points are and what they need from Kraken.

  • A genuine appetite to get into the weeds. You enjoy going deep on functional detail, rolling your sleeves up in the product, and building an intimate understanding of how the solution works and where its edges are — and you can then translate that depth into clear, business-relevant conversations.

  • The judgement to know how deep to go — technical and functional enough to earn credibility with architects, analysts and operations teams, while always framing the detail around client outcomes.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with a knack for making complicated things feel clear.

  • Openness and the ability to learn quickly and independently. Kraken moves fast, and the product does too.

  • A resourceful, adaptable approach — you find a way through rather than waiting for someone to hand you a perfect process.

  • Strong organisational skills across multiple deals, workshops, deadlines and client conversations.

  • Comfort operating across APAC markets and time zones, with flexibility to travel as needed to support sales efforts.

 

Even better if you have

  • Hands-on delivery or implementation experience with electricity distribution businesses / DNOs / DSOs — for example in network field services, meter data, connections, or DER management.

  • Experience in SaaS, solution consulting, pre-sales, implementation, business analysis or systems transformation in the energy industry.

  • Hands-on experience with network billing, metering, CIS, CRM, customer operations or customer communications platforms.

  • Familiarity with APAC energy markets and regulatory environments (e.g. Australia’s NEM).

  • Experience working with product and engineering teams to turn customer feedback into better product outcomes.

     

Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at inclusion@kraken.tech. We’ll do our best to tailor the experience to your needs so you can feel comfortable, confident and be at your best!

Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. We consider all applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

The team:

The Comms team builds and manages the technology that enables Kraken to communicate with customers across multiple channels, including phone, email, live chat and physical post. The team is responsible for both the underlying systems and the product features that support these customer interactions.

A key area of the team is voice and telephony, where they build the technology used by energy and support specialists to speak with customers. This includes managing real-time calls, handling customers and specialists joining or leaving calls, responding to connection and network issues, and ensuring calls can be reliably maintained or recovered when problems occur.

Unlike more traditional transactional backend systems, much of the Comms technology is highly real-time and event-driven. The team works with event streams, queues and continuously changing system states to manage interactions as they happen.
The team also integrates with third-party communication providers, such as Twilio, which supports Kraken’s phone networks and email sending.
Overall, Comms sits at the intersection of engineering, product and customer operations, building the technology that enables Kraken’s customer-facing teams to communicate effectively and reliably with customers.

What you’ll do:

  • Build and maintain the real-time technology that enables Kraken’s customer communication channels, with a particular focus on voice and telephony.

  • Develop reliable, event-driven systems that handle continuously changing states and interactions in real time.

  • Work with event streams, queues and asynchronous processes to manage customer and energy specialist interactions.

  • Build product features and tooling used by Kraken’s energy and support specialists to communicate with customers.

  • Solve complex real-time challenges, such as customers or specialists joining and leaving calls, connection issues and dropped calls.

  • Integrate Kraken’s systems with third-party communication providers, including platforms such as Twilio.

  • Take ownership of projects and contribute to improving the reliability, scalability and overall experience of Kraken’s communication systems.

  • Develop towards a people leadership role as the Comms team continues to grow.

We're looking for someone with a general interest in technology and problem-solving; someone diligent and thoughtful.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Design Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🐙 Kraken Generation Flex

The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. Japan is one of the largest energy markets in the world and is pursuing carbon neutrality by 2050. At Kraken, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid.

Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. We are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. We're growing fast in Japan. We already work with customers like Tokyo Gas as they scale their battery storage, renewables and DER portfolio, and we're onboarding new customers across the market. To support that growth, we're looking for a Senior Electrical Design Engineer to lead our regional technical market-access and integration efforts.

🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and customer growth in Japan, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Design Engineer to work with stakeholders to develop our DSR (Demand Side Response) and flexibility pipeline.

You will be bringing your regional technical expertise to aid the development of our asset integration technologies. The role is highly cross-functional: you'll bridge our software and hardware capabilities with the rigorous requirements of the diverse Japan power system.

The detailed Gateway (Kraken’s IoT Edge Hardware&Software) configuration and protocol engineering is owned by our UK-based team, whom you will feed with regional knowledge and design input, and who will support you on the technical aspects of how Kraken integrations work. You will own the regional relationship, the integration approach, and the design that the UK team then implements. The role will require you to attend calls with our Japanese clients, as well as calls with the TSOs and OCCTO to technically explain our system.

You will join a team that is innovative and engineering-focused, with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system.

🚀 What you'll own

  • Market Access & Prequalification: Drive the technical approach for connecting assets — mainly BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar) — into Japan’s markets

  • Integration Technology (your core deliverable): Carry out research, engage technical stakeholders and engineers to design our established integration approaches for various asset types such as BESS, Wind, Solar, CHP and more. This can cover both new projects and retrofits.

  • Regional Technical Expertise: Be the regional authority who feeds and supports the team with knowledge of Japanese hardware requirements, industrial protocols, connectivity, cyber-security expectations, and TSO and ancillary-service requirements. Help evaluate hardware and connectivity solutions for regional fit.

  • Gateway application & configuration: The role will be interdisciplinary. There will be opportunities to learn how the Gateway software (developed by an internal software team) works and how it is configured. You will be expected to understand the requirements for an integration and judge if the gateway software is able to support it or will need new development work. The team will help you get gateway configuration literate and you will be expected to carry out deployments and changes as necessary.

  • Stakeholder Liaison: Act as the technical point of contact for TSOs, customers, and internal commercial teams to resolve connection, onboarding, or operational issues.

  • Hardware & On-site Support (occasional): Hardware is deployed remotely in most cases via O&Ms and third parties. However, occasional regional support and hands-on intervention may be required before or after a deployment — including some hardware handling and on-site engineering. The role requires the ability to travel when needed, though this is kept to a minimum.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

Essential

  • Language: Native or professional fluency in Japanese and English — essential for technical documentation and TSO/regulator communication.

  • Engineering background: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration.

  • Integration & connectivity: Proven experience establishing industrial communication and connectivity between field equipment and external systems (telemetry and/or control).

  • Japan market knowledge:

  • The TSO / OCCTO hierarchy and the connection/integration process.

  • Supply-Demand Adjustment Market products (FCR, S-FRR, FRR, RR, RR-FIT) pre-qualification and technical requirements.

  • Awareness of the wider market context (JEPX wholesale market, OCCTO-run capacity market, METI/ANRE and the Electricity and Gas Market Surveillance Commission as regulators).

  • Customer-facing delivery: Ability to produce technical integration approaches and communicate them to customers, regulators, and internal teams.

  • Travel: Occasional travel may be required.

  • A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment, comfortable navigating the complexity of a multi-TSO, decentralised grid — and comfortable being the regional face of a technical function whose deep build sits with a partner team in the UK.

⭐️ Bonus points

  • Power-plant systems: Working understanding of power-plant control systems and instrumentation, including metering.

  • Knowledge of industrial communication protocols — IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25 (wind), OPC-UA, Modbus, or similar IEC protocols.

  • Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector, such as JC-STAR (IEC 62443 a plus).

  • Familiarity with CLI tools for configuring, diagnosing, and maintaining hardware or network connections in remote, Linux-based environments.

  • Familiarity with software languages, version-controlled configuration, and general tooling.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend - Python/Django)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

Kraken’s technology is written and maintained by a multi-discipline engineering team of around 1,400 people globally, which includes server-side, client-side, and mobile engineers. We follow an agile way of working, where individual teams are given the freedom to choose the tools that are most appropriate for managing their work.

Kraken is a great place to learn, work with talented engineers and level-up your skills. Some of our coding conventions are open-source.

This role is available remotely within Japan or hybrid from Tokyo

Our technology

Our backend developers use Python. Most of our websites are powered by Django and GraphQL (Graphene). Our CircleCI CI/CD pipeline runs tens of thousands of tests, deploying into AWS EKS defined by Terraform over 100 times per day and observed with tools like Sentry and Datadog. This allows us to move fast and at scale, without compromising reliability. Teams work differently but the commitment to quality is the same.

Developers at Kraken are empowered to use cutting-edge AI tools and models. Any generated code is still owned by a human.

What we do

Kraken Engineering has multiple disciplinary groups with their own management structures and teams working together to create a unified Kraken that can be deployed to any territory in the world to achieve clients’ goals.

At Kraken, you won't be boxed into one rigid path. Depending on your strengths and interests, you might find yourself modeling local energy markets, scaling a financial product across international territories, or driving the core comms engine behind all Kraken communications. Alternatively, you could be working directly with clients to enhance Kraken to solve their business needs or localise a particular market and help onboard their customers into the system. Whichever team you join, you’ll be solving complex problems with a group of genuinely great people.

🚀 What you’ll own:

  • Senior Engineers have not only strong engineering skills, but the ability to make cross-team and organizational impacts.

    • Technical & Architectural Ownership: Build robust, fault-tolerant software using Python, Django, GraphQL, Celery, and PostgreSQL. Apply deep architectural knowledge (e.g., separation of concerns, interfaces and refactoring practices like the Strangler Fig pattern or Chesterton’s Fence) to solve complex domain modeling challenges.

    • Leadership & Execution: Take on large milestones, driving their direction and cadence to consistently hit target dates while managing technical trade-offs.

    • Cross-Domain Bridge: Connect your team with related teams on cross-functional projects, quickly catching up on unfamiliar concepts and identifying critical points across domains.

    • Communication & Risk Management: Articulate technical points clearly across domains and to stakeholders at all levels of technical literacy using a "strong opinions, loosely held" approach.

    • Documentation & Standards: Set standards through your code and actions, ensure features and rollouts are thoroughly documented, and raise the engineering bar across the organization.

    • Mentorship: Sponsor and mentor engineers, helping them grow and reach the standards needed for promotion.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • Python & Django (or equivalent web framework)

  • Domain modeling and architectural design

  • GraphQL

  • Writing robust and fault-tolerant software

  • Celery and async processing

  • PostgreSQL

⭐️Bonus points:

  • AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes

  • Experience with one or more frontend frameworks

💜 What you'll love about us:

  • Flexible working environment - genuine work life balance here, we are in the top 5 companies in the UK, we treat you as a human, and do our best to make work and life merge smoothly together

  • Equity Options Scheme - you own your own part of the business, share options in Kraken so we all work together towards success

  • Office - have a certain tech requirement? We’ll do our best to get it. We also have drinks, snacks and a coffee machine at the office space on Bourke street.

  • Your development is important - we support and help with development including internal and external courses, learning, study support etc, all bespoke to you

Kraken is a certified Great Place to Work in France, Germany, Spain, Japan, Australia, and USA. In the UK we are one of the Best Workplaces on Glassdoor with a score of 4.5. Check out our Welcome to the Jungle site (FR/EN) to learn more about our teams and culture.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

Kraken’s technology is written and maintained by a multi-discipline engineering team of around 1,400 people globally, which includes server-side, client-side, and mobile engineers. We follow an agile way of working, where individual teams are given the freedom to choose the tools that are most appropriate for managing their work.

Kraken is a great place to learn, work with talented engineers and level-up your skills. Some of our coding conventions are open-source.

This role is available remotely within Japan or hybrid from Tokyo




OUR TECHNOLOGY

Our backend developers use Python. Most of our websites are powered by Django and GraphQL (Graphene). Our CircleCI CI/CD pipeline runs tens of thousands of tests, deploying into AWS EKS defined by Terraform over 100 times per day and observed with tools like Sentry and Datadog. This allows us to move fast and at scale, without compromising reliability. Teams work differently but the commitment to quality is the same.

Developers at Kraken are empowered to use cutting-edge AI tools and models. Any generated code is still owned by a human.


WHAT WE DO

Kraken Engineering has multiple disciplinary groups with their own management structures and teams working together to create a unified Kraken that can be deployed to any territory in the world to achieve clients’ goals.

At Kraken, you won't be boxed into one rigid path. Depending on your strengths and interests, you might find yourself modeling local energy markets, scaling a financial product across international territories, or driving the core comms engine behind all Kraken communications. Alternatively, you could be working directly with clients to enhance Kraken to solve their business needs or localise a particular market and help onboard their customers into the system. Whichever team you join, you’ll be solving complex problems with a group of genuinely great people.



🚀 What you’ll own:

 - Senior Engineers have not only strong engineering skills, but the ability to make cross-team and organizational impacts. 
   
   - Technical & Architectural Ownership: Build robust, fault-tolerant software using Python, Django, GraphQL, Celery, and PostgreSQL. Apply deep architectural knowledge (e.g., separation of concerns, interfaces and refactoring practices like the Strangler Fig pattern or Chesterton’s Fence) to solve complex domain modeling challenges.
   
   - Leadership & Execution: Take on large milestones, driving their direction and cadence to consistently hit target dates while managing technical trade-offs.
   
   - Cross-Domain Bridge: Connect your team with related teams on cross-functional projects, quickly catching up on unfamiliar concepts and identifying critical points across domains.
   
   - Communication & Risk Management: Articulate technical points clearly across domains and to stakeholders at all levels of technical literacy using a "strong opinions, loosely held" approach.
   
   - Documentation & Standards: Set standards through your code and actions, ensure features and rollouts are thoroughly documented, and raise the engineering bar across the organization.
   
   - Mentorship: Sponsor and mentor engineers, helping them grow and reach the standards needed for promotion.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

 - Python & Django (or equivalent web framework)

 - Domain modeling and architectural design

 - GraphQL

 - Writing robust and fault-tolerant software

 - Celery and async processing

 - PostgreSQL

⭐️Bonus points:

 - AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes

 - Experience with one or more frontend frameworks

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken is a technology company with a mission: helping energy utilities transform their operations to improve the lives of 1 billion people by accelerating the energy transition. We recognised that legacy technology has held the energy industry back for too long. At Kraken, we set out to change that.

 

Through successful partnerships with E.ON Next, EDF, Origin, Octopus Energy, and Tokyo Gas (to name just a few), we support over 60 million utility customers globally and we’ve expanded our offer to support businesses in the water and telco industries, meaning we're on track to achieve our mission of impacting 1 billion people within a decade.

 

We’ll never deliver on our ambitious goals without a team that is just as ambitious, so we’re expanding our tentacles and we are now looking for Senior Client Delivery Leads. The roles will be working closely with other members of the client delivery team to help with our APAC clients and global product teams. 

 

Join a team that's redefining energy. At Kraken, we're not just changing how energy companies work; we're tackling the climate crisis head-on. Our decisions are guided by simplicity, customer benefit, and efficiency and customer happiness first. If you're passionate about making a real difference with cutting-edge technology and a customer-centric approach, you belong with us.

🏠 Where you'll fit in: 

  • We are looking for more Senior Client Delivery Leads to join the Kraken delivery team. Ideally you’ll have experience working in the Australian energy sector or SaaS providers, and a lot of experience working with technical stakeholders (developers, QA, solution architects). If you love making things better for customers, building great products, working with technology, and bringing people together to find solutions, then you’ve come to the right place. We are looking for additions to our Client Delivery team that can help build our capability across our business with Kraken. 

  • Our Client Delivery Team exists to turn complex problems into amazing outcomes.  As a Senior Client Delivery Lead you’ll need to be comfortable working in partnership with the technology and operational teams at Kraken as well as the client. You’re going to need to live and breathe Kraken, and be as comfortable finding a meter read as you are trying to identify a customer need. 

  • Senior Client Delivery Leads need to understand how Kraken works, be able to help clients identify problems and refine solutions in the best way to leverage existing and new capability. They will bring technology, people and processes together to innovate improvements for our clients. They will deal with complexity across multiple customer journeys with a variety of customer types and end users.  This person will play a critical role in bringing all the right people together to deliver the roadmap.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • You’ll be a valued leader in our delivery teams.

  • You’ll need to be able to produce well articulated written documentation for our clients and our wider Kraken team. 

  • You’ll be facilitating and driving (sometimes ambiguous) conversations with clients in order to truly get to the root cause of their problems, and the options we have to solve it.

  • You’ll need to be comfortable taking a hands-on approach to verifying, testing, and demonstrating Kraken functionality to clients. 

  • You’ll need to get into the finer details at times, learning how to use tools like SQL and Kraken APIs to find the answers.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • You're a natural optimist, seeing every challenge as an opportunity to create something exceptional.. 

  • You’re inherently curious, always eager to learn and ask insightful questions 

  • You’ll have strong written and verbal communication skills to clearly explain and document complex ideas making them easily understandable. 

  • You’re self-aware to know your limits and know when to ask for help, while at the same time be happy to help out others when they need it. 

  • Thriving in a fast-paced, evolving environment comes naturally to you. 

  • You possess the self-confidence to push for the best customer outcome, balanced with empathy to understand diverse client needs.  

  • You’ll be confident in having respectful, constructive conversations, even when they’re challenging.

  • Be based in Melbourne, and be able to come into the office 3 days min per week

  • Support Visa operations: tracking visa types, right to work, and maintaining documentation/templates.

  • Maintain and localise policies, handbooks, and guides, whilst maintaining compliance according to local legislation.

  • Advise managers and employees on people tools and policies, ensuring a compliant and human-first experience.

  • Collaborate with Legal, IT, Talent, and Payroll to ensure smooth, secure, and compliant processes across geographies.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • Solid experience in People Operations or HR, ideally in high-growth and global environments.

  • Strong understanding of HR systems - especially Hibob and ATS tools (e.g. Ashby).

  • In this position you will be laser focused on satisfying our client’s needs.

jobs.title: Head of Corporate Development
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in:

Kraken is growing rapidly across markets, products and geographies. We've already completed five acquisitions, and we're looking for more.

We're seeking an exceptional Head of Corporate Development to identify and execute opportunities that materially accelerate our growth and strategy.

This is not simply an M&A role.

We want someone constantly asking: What could Kraken buy, invest in, partner with or build that would make us stronger, faster or more valuable to our clients?

You'll own our corporate development pipeline, originate opportunities and lead transactions from initial thesis through to execution.

That could mean an acquisition, strategic investment, joint venture, partnership or an entirely different commercial structure.

We care about the strategic outcome, not the transaction structure.

You'll work directly with Kraken's senior leadership and across Product, Engineering, Commercial, Finance and Legal.

🚀 What you’ll own:

Originate opportunities

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Customer

 

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like.

 

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

You will be joining the client delivery team with Kraken working to support European clients through their technology transformation journeys, supporting long term migration projects.

The Client Delivery Lead has direct responsibility managing a tech domain (billing, finance, comms..) for our client projects. This is either migrating onto our Kraken platform or managing long term technology requirements. They need to work in partnership with the technology and operational teams at Kraken as well as the client to deliver results for our client’s project or business needs.

 

The Client Delivery Lead has to really understand how Kraken works, understand problems or requests raised by the client and refine solutions in the best way to leverage existing and new capability. They will bring technology, people and processes together to innovate improvements for our clients. You will also support the client in adapting to ways of working that are aligned to Kraken’s development style. You will work closely with Kraken’s product managers and developers to request development needs and act as a link to the client.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • You will be managing the relationship with client counterparts (often product owners and business owners)

  • You will be the first point of contact for tech development and the escalation and resolution point with customers for specific domain/product issues

  • Being the knowledge base of how Kraken works and how we deliver Kraken Platform

  • Triaging incoming requests and communicating client priorities internally.

  • Summarising and articulating client needs, considerations, timelines internally to enable the ongoing development of the Kraken platform.

  • Supporting the engineering team to deliver product features

  • Challenging the client to think differently about tech development, having full belief in the continuous iteration and deployment approach we have.

 

This is a hands-on, individual contributor position. The role is European based and your projects could be run from any country, travel is expected as part of this role.

 

We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever changing environment. To thrive here you must be a self-starter and willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem, constantly flexing outside of your typical job role to drive progress for our clients and organisation.

You must be committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing stakeholders through a journey of change.

 

You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client.

 

We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • In this position you will be laser focused on satisfying our customer’s needs. We are looking for people with strong problem solving skills and a super positive solutions oriented mindset. If you have a taste for raising up to challenges and a winner mindset, this position is the right fit for you! (“Every problem has a solution, facing new challenges is exciting because that’s what makes us better every day and the bigger the challenge, the bigger the feeling of success”)

  • Strong client delivery and/or product ownership experience

  • Agile delivery experience

  • Experience of product management and customer journeys

  • Solid understanding of technology and associated trends

  • Excellent communications, collaboration and presentation skills

  • Strong influencing skills and ability to challenge traditional ways of thinking

  • Experience of working with significant complex delivery pipelines for clients

  • Patience and initiative - our clients are undergoing huge transformations that take time and require our understanding

  • Time management and a get-stuff-done attitude

  • Consulting experience is a plus

  • Fluent English + German

  • Previous experience in accounting and billing or payments is nice to have for this position

If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you.

The role

 

You’ll work directly with Kraken clients to help them develop modern, transformative data and analytics capabilities as part of their broader Kraken transformation. You’ll train them on Kraken data and support them in building critical reporting & insightful analytics, sometimes getting hands-on with query writing or demo analytics. 

 

You’ll also leverage your experience leading strong analytics teams to advise senior client data leadership on how to build a high-performing, business-centric data organization and leverage data as a strategic asset to unlock ambitious business and clean energy goals.

 

We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for a hands-on Data & Analytics Client Delivery Lead that can support both directly and indirectly - sometimes jumping in and writing queries or solving data challenges and other times advising or upskilling both clients and colleagues. 

 

You will play a critical role in ensuring the clients’ reporting and analytics transition to Kraken goes smoothly - and ensuring that clients build the transformative data capabilities needed to get full value from Kraken data and power aspirational business goals.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • Guide clients in redefining critical reporting and analytics to use new Kraken data and concepts, through hands-on query writing, working sessions, and trainings

  • Advise clients, including senior leadership, on topics like how to develop a high-performing data organization, how to build a modern tech stack, and how to pursue a data strategy and priorities that drive their core business objectives.

  • Strategically define and prioritize client data needs to influence the data product roadmap, ensuring product understands the core, shared client needs and that solutions achieve clients’ desired business outcomes

  • Partner with engineering to deliver new data features and requirements aligned to client use cases

  • Train Kraken’s broader client delivery team on how to help their respective business domains ask effective data questions and leverage data directly to drive business impact

🧠 What you’ll bring to the party:

  • Degree qualified equivalent, with strong client delivery and/or product ownership experience

  • Several years of experience as a data analytics, business intelligence, or related field -- analytics manager, lead data analyst, analytics or data consultant or similar

  • Strong familiarity with modern data practices and tools

  • Strong facility with SQL and modern BI toolsFamiliar with agile product development practices and experience collaborating with engineering

  • Excellent communications, collaboration and presentation skills

  • Strong influencing skills and ability to challenge traditional ways of thinking

  • Patience – our clients are undergoing huge transformations that take time and require our understanding

  • Experience in the energy sector a plus

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

 

We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. 

 

This role will lead the technical orchestration of a major client program, partnering with an energy retailer in their operational transformation. You will oversee the migration’s technical pillar and manage the ongoing technical relationship, supporting the client’s adoption of our Kraken platform as part of their broader business transformation.

 

We work incredibly dynamically, and this role is one that will take different shapes throughout the week. We are looking for well rounded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity, are self-starters and willing to roll their sleeves up to get to the nitty gritty of a problem. You must be  committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing senior stakeholders through a journey of change. 

 

You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client. 

 

We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • Building trusted relationships with client executives and technology stakeholders, including partnering with our product and engineering teams to align on priorities. Serving as the escalation point for client concerns and ensuring both technical challenges and product requirements are effectively managed

  • Defining success criteria and governance for delivering the technical pillar of the program. 

  • Owning the Kraken platform localisation plan to meet client expectations while matching Kraken roadmap

  •  Summarising and articulating client needs, considerations, timelines, etc internally as structured input for the successful and timely execution of any required technology platform localisation and development.

  • Directing internal Kraken software developers contributing to the client program, as well as potential external Partners, on tech platform deliverables to ensure  an overall successful and timely  technology migration.

  • Supporting the client meets their business needs via the delivery of tech. 

  • Understanding the Kraken infrastructure, aligning client direction with the overall goal for the Kraken platform & business. 

  • Setting up training programs to upskill the technical arm of the client. 

  • Being an advocate for the Kraken way of delivering tech and supporting the client in shifting their mindset around tech delivery

 

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • Communication: You need to be confident in calling out approaches that aren't best for the client and always striving for simplicity.  You need to be able to communicate the context behind decisions relating to the platform & client priorities. You must be able to build strong relationships and credibility amongst senior stakeholders, balancing the needs of the client with Kraken’s business needs and platform potential and constraints.   

  • Program management: Confident in managing a long term, fast paced program. Can be both high level and dive into detail when required. Ability to directly manage a team and manage processes that can drive the right outcomes for clients. 

  • Strong technical aptitude: We are looking for a logical thinker who has strong problem solving skills within an agile working framework. Must quickly be able to grasp the technical capabilities and constraints of the Kraken platform. Is an advocate for the continuous deployment approach we take at Kraken and champions building tech iteratively. 

  • Business acumen: Able to understand business goals of both client and Kraken, putting all technology decisions into context to ensure measurable success can be achieved and celebrated.

  • You are based in Tokyo area

Experience / Qualifications needed:

  • Technical mindset, experience in engineering-led industries 

  • Experience in managing complex technology implementation or migration programs

  • Proven experience in software adaptation, deployment and integration

  • Exceptional interpersonal skills 

  • Fluent in Japanese, business level of English
